errors:a-little-bit-earlier-comparative.title: 用 a little bit 表“稍早一点”时要用比较级 earlier
errors:a-little-bit-earlier-comparative.explanation: “出发早一点”对比的是计划时间，应使用比较级 earlier 而不是原级 early；“出发”也更自然用 leave 而非 go。
errors:a-little-bit-earlier-comparative.source: Can we go a little bit early?
errors:a-little-bit-earlier-comparative.example: Can we leave a little bit earlier?

errors:a-little-bit-of-noun-missing-of.title: a little bit 后接名词时缺少 of
errors:a-little-bit-of-noun-missing-of.explanation: a little bit 修饰不可数名词时须用 a little bit of + 名词，不能把 a little bit 直接贴到名词前；recently 常与现在完成时搭配，口语中 luck 比 good fortune 更自然。
errors:a-little-bit-of-noun-missing-of.source: He has a little bit good fortune recently.
errors:a-little-bit-of-noun-missing-of.example: He's had a little bit of good luck recently.

errors:abstract-price-needs-indefinite-a.title: 抽象代价 price 前需要不定冠词，且不宜用 need 硬译“需要代价”
errors:abstract-price-needs-indefinite-a.explanation: 表示“要付出的代价”时，price 是可数单数抽象名词，必须有限定词：a price。而中文“需要付出代价”不能直译成 need price，英语更常用 there is a price to pay for sth 或 sth comes at a price，把代价处理成事物自带的属性，而不是用 need 表示需求。
errors:abstract-price-needs-indefinite-a.source: Any shortcuts need price to pay and the most expansive things at later.
errors:abstract-price-needs-indefinite-a.example: Every shortcut comes at a price, and there is always a price to pay for it.

errors:accompany-mistaken-as-company-ver.title: 陪伴某人用 accompany，不用 company
errors:accompany-mistaken-as-company-ver.explanation: accompany 是动词，表示陪伴；company 通常是名词“公司”或“陪伴这一状态”，不能在这里直接作动词表示陪伴。
errors:accompany-mistaken-as-company-ver.source: After living for years in Seattle, he decided back east to company his parents.
errors:accompany-mistaken-as-company-ver.example: He moved back east to accompany his parents.

errors:accompany-someone-to-place-no-go.title: accompany 后直接接人和目的地
errors:accompany-someone-to-place-no-go.explanation: accompany someone to the airport 已经包含陪某人去机场的意思，不需要再加 to go；airport 前通常加 the。
errors:accompany-someone-to-place-no-go.source: I will accompany you to go airport.
errors:accompany-someone-to-place-no-go.example: I will accompany you to the airport.

errors:accuse-for-correction-feedback.title: 把 accuse 误用于指出或纠正问题
errors:accuse-for-correction-feedback.explanation: accuse 表示指控、责备某人做错事，不能自然表示别人指出发音、拼写这类具体问题。表达纠正或指出问题时，应使用 correct someone、point out a mistake/problem 或 point out a problem with ...。
errors:accuse-for-correction-feedback.source: She usually listen carefully if some accuse her pronunciation problem.
errors:accuse-for-correction-feedback.example: She usually listens carefully if someone points out a problem with her pronunciation.

errors:accuse-someone-of-gerund-not-that.title: accuse 后使用 of 加动名词
errors:accuse-someone-of-gerund-not-that.explanation: accuse 的固定结构是 accuse someone of doing something，不能直接使用 accuse someone that；因此应说 was accused of deceiving customers。
errors:accuse-someone-of-gerund-not-that.source: He was accused that he deceived customers.
errors:accuse-someone-of-gerund-not-that.example: He was accused of deceiving customers.

errors:accuse-vs-correct-word-choice.title: accuse 与 correct 的语义边界
errors:accuse-vs-correct-word-choice.explanation: accuse 表示指控或责备某人做错事；别人指出发音问题时更自然用 correct someone 或 point out a mistake。

errors:administrative-chef-translated-as.title: 行政主厨误译为 government main chef
errors:administrative-chef-translated-as.explanation: 「行政主厨」是职位名称 executive chef（也可说 head chef），这里的「行政」指管理职务而非政府；government 只表示「政府的」，不能拿来对应职位里的「行政」。
errors:administrative-chef-translated-as.source: The government main chef is responsible for the design of the menu.
errors:administrative-chef-translated-as.example: The executive chef is responsible for the menu design every morning.

errors:advice-uncountable-many-error.title: advice 是不可数名词，不能说 many advice
errors:advice-uncountable-many-error.explanation: advice 是不可数名词，不能直接用 many 修饰；要说 a lot of advice、much advice，或 a piece of advice。
errors:advice-uncountable-many-error.example: My teacher dished out a lot of advice before the exam.

errors:after-all-front-position-for-give.title: after all 给出理由时放句首并加逗号更自然
errors:after-all-front-position-for-give.explanation: after all 用来给理由或修正预期时，最常见是置于句首后接逗号（After all, this is his first time.），放在句末且不加逗号会显得生硬。
errors:after-all-front-position-for-give.source: This is his first time after all.
errors:after-all-front-position-for-give.example: After all, this is his first time.

errors:after-clause-missing-subject-befo.title: after 引导从句时缺少主语和谓语形式
errors:after-clause-missing-subject-befo.explanation: after 作从属连词后面接完整从句时，需要主语和谓语，例如 after they signed the contract；如果省略主语，应改成介词结构 after signing the contract，而不是 after signed the contract。
errors:after-clause-missing-subject-befo.source: After signed the contract, they proceeded to discuss the payment details.
errors:after-clause-missing-subject-befo.example: After they signed the contract, they proceeded to discuss the payment details.

errors:after-clause-without-main-clause.title: after + 完整分句不能单独收尾
errors:after-clause-without-main-clause.explanation: after 引导的是从属分句，必须有主句支撑；“and after he went back east”没有主句，形成残缺句，应改用 later、afterwards 或 then。
errors:after-clause-without-main-clause.source: and after he went back east
errors:after-clause-without-main-clause.example: and later moved back east to his hometown.

errors:after-event-noun-phrase.title: 用 after + 名词短语表达事件之后
errors:after-event-noun-phrase.explanation: 表示“午饭后、短暂休息后”时，自然表达是 after lunch、after a short rest 或 after a short break；after lunching 很少这样说，after short resting 也不自然。
errors:after-event-noun-phrase.source: After lunching, we proceeded to visit the factory. / After short resting, she continue on performing.
errors:after-event-noun-phrase.example: After a short rest, she continued with her presentation.

errors:after-subordinator-used-for-later.title: 把 after 从属连词误当 later 连接后续动作
errors:after-subordinator-used-for-later.explanation: 表达“后来做了某事”时，after 不能单独承接一个完整后续动作；after he got a better job 会变成从属时间从句，后面还缺主句。应用 later、then、afterward，或说 after that。
errors:after-subordinator-used-for-later.source: He failed the first interview, but after he got a better job.
errors:after-subordinator-used-for-later.example: He failed the first interview, but later he got a better job.

errors:after-time-clause-future-tense.title: after 时间从句在未来语境误用过去时
errors:after-time-clause-future-tense.explanation: 主句用 will 表示将来时，after/once 等时间从句要用一般现在时或现在完成时，不用过去时。after we received 应改为 after we receive，或写成被动 after all the documents are confirmed。
errors:after-time-clause-future-tense.source: We'll proceed with your visa application after we received all the documents.
errors:after-time-clause-future-tense.example: We will proceed with your visa application after all the documents are confirmed.

errors:age-expression-twenty-years.title: 年龄表达：when he was twenty years 不完整
errors:age-expression-twenty-years.explanation: 表示“他二十岁的时候”，可以说 when he was twenty、at twenty 或 in his twenties；twenty years 需要再接 old，否则缺少形容词，句意不成立。
errors:age-expression-twenty-years.example: He spent a few years out west in his twenties.

errors:all-plus-plural-noun.title: all 后面接复数或不可数名词
errors:all-plus-plural-noun.explanation: all 修饰可数名词时必须用复数形式，all customer 要写成 all customers。
errors:all-plus-plural-noun.example: We made it free for all customers.

errors:all-the-time-vs-anytime.title: all the time（总是）≠ anytime（随时）
errors:all-the-time-vs-anytime.explanation: all the time 表示频率「一直、总是」；要表达「随时可以出发」应用 anytime 或 at any time。另外 The luggage is all set, we can go … 用逗号直接连接两个句子构成逗号拼接，应改为 and/so 连接或分成两句。
errors:all-the-time-vs-anytime.source: The luggage is all set, we can go all the time.
errors:all-the-time-vs-anytime.example: The luggage is all packed, so we can leave anytime.

errors:and-then-clause-needs-finite-verb.title: and then 后面必须是带时态的完整分句
errors:and-then-clause-needs-finite-verb.explanation: and then 连接的是完整分句，被动语态要写 was/were + 过去分词；只写 be bought 没有时态，句子不成立。
errors:and-then-clause-needs-finite-verb.source: and then be bought by a bigger company
errors:and-then-clause-needs-finite-verb.example: and was later acquired by a larger competitor

errors:application-vs-applicant-for-requ.title: application 与 applicant 的混淆
errors:application-vs-applicant-for-requ.explanation: application 是“申请、申请表、申请材料”；applicant 是“申请人”。当主语是正在被审查的申请时，应说 My application is still under review.
errors:application-vs-applicant-for-requ.source: My applicant is still under review.
errors:application-vs-applicant-for-requ.example: My application is still under review.

errors:approved-not-past-perfect.title: 「已经批准」用现在完成，不必用过去完成时
errors:approved-not-past-perfect.explanation: 现在完成 has approved 表示过去的批准动作对现在有影响；过去完成 had approved 需要另一个过去时间点作为参照，单独说“已经批准”用现在完成或一般过去。
errors:approved-not-past-perfect.source: The headquarters had approved our budget proposal.
errors:approved-not-past-perfect.example: Our headquarters has approved our budget proposal.

errors:as-a-kid-missing-article.title: “小时候”表达 as a kid 需加冠词 a
errors:as-a-kid-missing-article.explanation: kid 是可数名词单数，as a kid 需加不定冠词 a；另外“公园”对应 park，garden 指花园。
errors:as-a-kid-missing-article.source: He used to play in the garden as kid.
errors:as-a-kid-missing-article.example: He used to play in the park as a kid.

errors:as-soon-as-not-as-long-as-for-imm.title: 一……就……用 as soon as，而非 as long as
errors:as-soon-as-not-as-long-as-for-imm.explanation: as soon as 表示一个动作发生后另一个动作立即发生；as long as 通常表示“只要”这一条件或“长达”某段时间。
errors:as-soon-as-not-as-long-as-for-imm.source: I recognize her voice as long as she speaks.
errors:as-soon-as-not-as-long-as-for-imm.example: I recognized her voice as soon as she spoke.

errors:at-the-second-intersection-for-di.title: 指路时用 at the second intersection 表示在第二个路口
errors:at-the-second-intersection-for-di.explanation: 指路语境中的“路口”通常是 intersection；序数词 second 前需要定冠词 the，并用 at 表示转弯发生的位置。
errors:at-the-second-intersection-for-di.source: Continue along this road until you see second road and turn right.
errors:at-the-second-intersection-for-di.example: Continue along this road and turn right at the second intersection.

errors:auxiliary-do-not-followed-by-past.title: do not 后误用过去式动词
errors:auxiliary-do-not-followed-by-past.explanation: 助动词 do/does/did 已经承担时态或否定功能，后面的实义动词要用原形，所以不要说 do not said，而要说 do not say。
errors:auxiliary-do-not-followed-by-past.source: Please do not said he accused your grammer mistake, and he just help you accuse them.
errors:auxiliary-do-not-followed-by-past.example: Please do not say he accused you of grammar mistakes; he just helped you correct them.

errors:back-east-direction-misuse.title: back east 不能表示西行方向
errors:back-east-direction-misuse.explanation: back east 通常指美国东部或从其他地区回望美国东部，不能用来描述从纽约去洛杉矶这类西向行程；这种语境应说 travel west、travel westward，或直接说 travel to Los Angeles。
errors:back-east-direction-misuse.source: She lives in New York and travels to Los Angeles back east every summer.
errors:back-east-direction-misuse.example: She lives in New York and travels west to Los Angeles every summer.

errors:back-east-for-westbound-us-destin.title: 去美国西部城市不能用 back east
errors:back-east-for-westbound-us-destin.explanation: back east 表示回到美国东部或熟悉的东部地区；Seattle、Los Angeles、San Francisco 等在美国西部，从 New York 或 Boston 去这些地方应说 go/move west 或 westward。
errors:back-east-for-westbound-us-destin.source: He moved back east to Seattle from New York.
errors:back-east-for-westbound-us-destin.example: He moved west to Seattle from New York.

errors:back-east-needs-explicit-region.title: 语境里要保留 back east
errors:back-east-needs-explicit-region.explanation: 在这个短语里，back east 不是可随意删掉的装饰，而是表达“美国东部/老家在东部”的核心信息。改写时如果只保留 city，就会丢失原短语的地域含义。
errors:back-east-needs-explicit-region.source: He said his parents are from the city back east.
errors:back-east-needs-explicit-region.example: He said his parents are from back east.

errors:back-west-spacing.title: out west 不是 outwest
errors:back-west-spacing.explanation: 表示“在西部”时，英语里通常写作 out west，而不是把它连写成一个词。
errors:back-west-spacing.source: She grew up back east and now lives in outwest.
errors:back-west-spacing.example: She grew up back east and now lives out west.

errors:base-verb-after-does-in-direct-qu.title: 直接疑问句里 do/does 后面要接动词原形
errors:base-verb-after-does-in-direct-qu.explanation: 在直接问题 What does this word ... 中，does 已经承担了时态和疑问功能，后面的实义动词要回到原形 mean，而不是 meant。
errors:base-verb-after-does-in-direct-qu.source: "What does this word meant?" she asked him.
errors:base-verb-after-does-in-direct-qu.example: "What does this word mean?" she asked him.

errors:be-preparing-present-progressive.title: 现在进行时需要 be 加现在分词
errors:be-preparing-present-progressive.explanation: 主语 mom 后面已有 is，因此 prepare 要变成现在分词 preparing；表示正在准备晚餐时应说 is preparing dinner。
errors:be-preparing-present-progressive.source: The children are setting the table and mom is prepare for dinner.
errors:be-preparing-present-progressive.example: The children are setting the table, and Mom is preparing dinner.

errors:be-used-to-describe-not-used-to-p.title: be used to describe 不能省略 describe
errors:be-used-to-describe-not-used-to-p.explanation: 表示“被用来形容/描述某类人”时，英语常说 be used to describe people；used to 后面不能直接接 the people 表示“形容这些人”。
errors:be-used-to-describe-not-used-to-p.source: They say the word is used to the people from the big cities.
errors:be-used-to-describe-not-used-to-p.example: The word was used to describe people who had just arrived from big cities.

errors:before-begin-gerund-or-clause.title: before 后不能直接接 begin 原形动词
errors:before-begin-gerund-or-clause.explanation: before 后面接动作时，常用 before + -ing，或 before + 完整从句；不能说 before begin doing。
errors:before-begin-gerund-or-clause.source: The guide asked tourists to turn off their phones before begin visiting.
errors:before-begin-gerund-or-clause.example: The guide asked the tourists to turn off their phones before beginning the tour.

errors:before-clause-present-tense-for-f.title: before 从句用过去时表达将来
errors:before-clause-present-tense-for-f.explanation: before 引导的时间从句在将来语境里用一般现在时表将来，不能用 came 或 will come；主句 should leave 已承担情态与将来含义。
errors:before-clause-present-tense-for-f.source: We should leave before the storm came.
errors:before-clause-present-tense-for-f.example: We should leave before the storm comes.

errors:but-clause-needs-finite-verb.title: but 后并列分句需要谓语动词
errors:but-clause-needs-finite-verb.explanation: but 连接两个完整分句时，后半句需要有限谓语；不能只写 but living，应写 but they later settled 或 but now live。
errors:but-clause-needs-finite-verb.source: My grandparent comes from back east, but living in ...
errors:but-clause-needs-finite-verb.example: My grandparents came from back east, but they later settled in Arizona.

errors:calm-not-quiet-for-composure.title: 淡定用 calm，不用 quiet
errors:calm-not-quiet-for-composure.explanation: quiet 指声音小或人不爱说话，描述遇事不慌的心理状态要用 calm（也可以说 stay calm / keep one's cool）。
errors:calm-not-quiet-for-composure.example: He stays so calm — he has done it many times, after all.

errors:cannot-written-as-one-word.title: 正式书面语里 cannot 是一个词，不拆成 can not
errors:cannot-written-as-one-word.explanation: 正式文本表示「不能」时标准拼写是 cannot（一个词）；can not 只在刻意强调否定（can not ... but ...）等少数字面结构中出现，普通通知、公告、论文里写成 can not 属于拼写不规范。
errors:cannot-written-as-one-word.source: Please notice that late submissions can not be accepted after 5 pm.
errors:cannot-written-as-one-word.example: Please note that late submissions cannot be accepted after 5 p.m.

errors:capitalize-english-language-name.title: 语言名称 English 要大写
errors:capitalize-english-language-name.explanation: English 作为语言名称和专有名词使用时首字母要大写；写成 english 是拼写格式错误。

errors:clouds-are-not-piece-of-clouds.title: 云通常用 clouds 表达
errors:clouds-are-not-piece-of-clouds.explanation: 表示云朵从某个地点上方飘过，要用 drifted over 或 flew over；the top of mountain 缺少限定词，也不如 the mountain peak 自然。
errors:clouds-are-not-piece-of-clouds.source: In the afternoon, some piece of clouds flew the top of mountain.
errors:clouds-are-not-piece-of-clouds.example: In the afternoon, some clouds drifted over the mountain peak.

errors:comma-splice-two-independent-clau.title: 两个完整句子之间不能用逗号连接
errors:comma-splice-two-independent-clau.explanation: 两个各自能独立成句的主谓结构放在一起，必须用句号、分号或并列连词（and/but）连接；只用逗号会造成 comma splice。
errors:comma-splice-two-independent-clau.source: I played basketball in the morning, afterwards, I had my lunch.
errors:comma-splice-two-independent-clau.example: I played basketball in the morning; afterwards, I had lunch.

errors:common-place-name-english-not-pin.title: 常见地名应用英文名而不是拼音
errors:common-place-name-english-not-pin.explanation: 翻译城市名时，常见英文地名要使用约定英文名；温哥华是 Vancouver，不写作 wengehua。
errors:common-place-name-english-not-pin.source: We will go travel to wengehua to visit our friends next year.
errors:common-place-name-english-not-pin.example: We will go to Vancouver to visit our friends next year.

errors:company-was-founded-in-year.title: 成立于某年用 was founded in + 年份
errors:company-was-founded-in-year.explanation: 记录公司或机构的成立年份用一般过去时 was founded / was established + in + 年份；一般现在时 becomes 表习惯或状态变化，不能带 by 2015 这类年份状语。

errors:competitor-not-company.title: “竞争对手”用 competitor 或 rival，不是 company
errors:competitor-not-company.explanation: company 指公司本身，不表示与己方竞争的一方；表达“竞争对手”要用 competitor 或 rival，比较时写 a larger competitor。

errors:completed-action-uses-past-tense-.title: 表达已经完成的找到动作时误用一般现在时
errors:completed-action-uses-past-tense-.explanation: 中文里的“找到了”强调动作已经完成，英语通常用一般过去时 found，而不是一般现在时 finds。
errors:completed-action-uses-past-tense-.source: The student finds a useful book in the library.
errors:completed-action-uses-past-tense-.example: The student found a useful book in the library.

errors:continue-on-keeps-on-not-with-dis.title: continue on 表沿路线继续，距离不跟 with
errors:continue-on-keeps-on-not-with-dis.explanation: continue on 本身已含「继续向前」，距离直接作状语跟在后面（continue on for another two miles），再加 ahead 属冗余；continue with 只接活动、流程或内容，不能接距离或里程。
errors:continue-on-keeps-on-not-with-dis.source: The bridge is under repair, so we need to continue with another two miles.
errors:continue-on-keeps-on-not-with-dis.example: The bridge is under repair, so we need to continue on for another two miles.（桥在维修，所以我们要继续往前开两英里）

errors:continue-with-means-content-not-m.title: continue with 表示接续内容，不表示沿路线前行
errors:continue-with-means-content-not-m.explanation: continue with + 名词 指接着做某项活动、流程或内容（会议议程里的下一项），与表示沿当前路线继续前进的 continue on 分工不同；把 continue with 理解成空间位移就会混淆这两个结构。
errors:continue-with-means-content-not-m.source: A. 我们沿当前这条路线继续往前走
errors:continue-with-means-content-not-m.example: Let's continue with the next item.（我们接着进入议程里的下一项内容）

errors:contraction-isnt-apostrophe-mispl.title: 缩写 isn't 的撇号位置错误
errors:contraction-isnt-apostrophe-mispl.explanation: is not 的标准缩写是 isn't，撇号放在 n 和 t 之间，代替被省略的 o。写成 isnt' 或 isnt 都是缩写形态错误，在书面语中会显得不规范。
errors:contraction-isnt-apostrophe-mispl.source: Lovely day for take the children to the zoo, isnt' it?
errors:contraction-isnt-apostrophe-mispl.example: Lovely day to take the children to the zoo, isn't it?

errors:cool-breeze-adjective-omitted.title: 翻译凉爽的微风时不要漏掉 cool
errors:cool-breeze-adjective-omitted.explanation: 中文说“凉爽的微风”时，英文里 breeze 只表达轻柔的风，不自动包含“凉爽”；需要加 cool，写作 a cool breeze。
errors:cool-breeze-adjective-omitted.source: There was a breeze from the sea.
errors:cool-breeze-adjective-omitted.example: There was a cool breeze from the sea.

errors:countable-noun-missing-article.title: 可数名词单数前缺冠词
errors:countable-noun-missing-article.explanation: continue with the presentation、a five-minute rest、the tea break 这类可数名词单数前需要 a/the，不能裸写 presentation / rest / tea break。
errors:countable-noun-missing-article.source: After five-minute rest, we continued with presentation.
errors:countable-noun-missing-article.example: After a five-minute rest, we continued with the presentation.

errors:decide-requires-to-infinitive-for.title: decide 后需要接 to do 表示决定做某事
errors:decide-requires-to-infinitive-for.explanation: decide 后接具体行动时使用 decide to + 动词原形，因此应说 decided to move back east 或 decided to go back east。不能直接把 back east 接在 decided 后面。
errors:decide-requires-to-infinitive-for.source: After living for years in Seattle, he decided back east to company his parents.
errors:decide-requires-to-infinitive-for.example: After living in Seattle for years, he decided to move back east to be with his parents.

errors:demonstration-vs-show-formal-even.title: 正式会议语境用 equipment show 指设备演示
errors:demonstration-vs-show-formal-even.explanation: show 偏展览会、演出，指会议中的功能演示应用 demonstration 或 demo，与 equipment 的搭配也更自然。
errors:demonstration-vs-show-formal-even.source: ... let's proceed to the equipment show.
errors:demonstration-vs-show-formal-even.example: ... let's proceed to the equipment demonstration.

errors:did-use-to-base-form.title: Did 后用 use to，不用 used to
errors:did-use-to-base-form.explanation: 一般过去时疑问句由 did 承担过去时标记，后面的动词使用原形，因此写 Did you use to live back east?。
errors:did-use-to-base-form.source: Did you used to live back east?
errors:did-use-to-base-form.example: Did you use to live back east?

errors:direct-question-word-order-and-lo.title: 直接问句语序与 look at 介词保留
errors:direct-question-word-order-and-lo.explanation: 直接问句要使用疑问词加助动词或 be 动词前置，如 When is she free?；表达“可以看的照片”时，look at 的介词 at 不能省略。
errors:direct-question-word-order-and-lo.source: When she is free and if she has old pictures to look.
errors:direct-question-word-order-and-lo.example: When is she free, and does she have any old photos I could look at?

errors:direction-vs-home-area-contrast.title: eastward cannot replace back east
errors:direction-vs-home-area-contrast.explanation: eastward only means toward the east and does not carry the familiar or homeward sense that back east has.
errors:direction-vs-home-area-contrast.source: After years in California, he moved eastward to be closer to his family.
errors:direction-vs-home-area-contrast.example: After years in California, he moved back east to be closer to his family.

errors:dish-up-register-informal-for-for.title: 把 dish up 用在正式酒店宣传册里
errors:dish-up-register-informal-for-for.explanation: dish up 表示「把饭菜端上/摆上桌」，属于偏口语、家常的说法，用于宣传册、酒店介绍这类正式书面语域不合适；同样表达「供应/端上」，serve 更中性，正式场合更合适。
errors:dish-up-register-informal-for-for.source: 合适（判断 The hotel dished up breakfast for its guests 适合正式宣传册）
errors:dish-up-register-informal-for-for.example: The hotel serves breakfast to its guests from seven to ten.

errors:double-consonant-in-stopped.title: stop 的过去式拼作 stopped
errors:double-consonant-in-stopped.explanation: stop 是重读闭音节结尾的单音节动词，变过去式时双写末尾辅音 p，再加 -ed。
errors:double-consonant-in-stopped.source: A yellow car stoped at the hotel gate.
errors:double-consonant-in-stopped.example: A yellow taxi stopped at the hotel entrance.

errors:down-south-up-north-not-out-south.title: down south / up north：方位短语的固定搭配
errors:down-south-up-north-not-out-south.explanation: 英语里表示“在南方/到南方”常说 down south，表示“在北方/到北方”常说 up north，不能按 out west 的模板类推成 out south、out north。
errors:down-south-up-north-not-out-south.example: They spend every winter down south, and her brother took a job up north.

errors:drive-westward-past-tense.title: “开车向西穿过”过去动作应用 drove
errors:drive-westward-past-tense.explanation: “他们开车向西穿过了沙漠”是过去完成的事件，应用过去式 drove；现在时 drive 表示一般习惯。沙漠用 across the desert。
errors:drive-westward-past-tense.example: They drove westward across the desert.

errors:drizzle-vs-shower-for-duration-pa.title: 短暂阵雨用 shower，细小持续雨用 drizzle
errors:drizzle-vs-shower-for-duration-pa.explanation: shower 强调一阵短暂的雨，常可反复出现；drizzle 强调雨滴细小、雨势轻，常给人持续潮湿的感觉。
errors:drizzle-vs-shower-for-duration-pa.example: There may be several showers this afternoon, but the morning will stay grey with light drizzle.

errors:duration-compound-adjective-needs.title: 时长作复合形容词时需要连字符
errors:duration-compound-adjective-needs.explanation: 表示继续某项活动时，continue with the meeting 比 continue on meeting 自然；continue on 通常表示继续前进或继续做某事，后面不直接这样接 meeting。
errors:duration-compound-adjective-needs.source: After ten-minute rest, we continued on meeting.
errors:duration-compound-adjective-needs.example: After a ten-minute rest, we continued with the meeting.

errors:duration-rest-possessive-or-hyphe.title: ten minutes rest 缺少所有格或复合形容词结构
errors:duration-rest-possessive-or-hyphe.explanation: 表示一段时间的休息，可以说 after ten minutes of rest、after a ten-minute rest，或较正式地说 after ten minutes rest with an apostrophe after minutes。直接写 ten minutes rest 不够完整。
errors:duration-rest-possessive-or-hyphe.source: After ten minutes rest, he continued with his project presentation.
errors:duration-rest-possessive-or-hyphe.example: After a ten-minute rest, he continued with his project presentation.

errors:eastward-for-westbound-us-travel.title: eastward 不能表示从美国东部去美国西部
errors:eastward-for-westbound-us-travel.explanation: 从 Boston/New York 去 San Francisco/Seattle/Los Angeles 这类美国西海岸城市，方向应是 west 或 westward；eastward 表示向东，方向相反。
errors:eastward-for-westbound-us-travel.source: C. He moved eastward to Seattle from New York.
errors:eastward-for-westbound-us-travel.example: He moved west to Seattle after graduation.

errors:eastward-used-for-westbound-trip.title: eastward 不能修饰西向行程
errors:eastward-used-for-westbound-trip.explanation: eastward 表示“向东”，与从芝加哥去旧金山这种向西的路线不符；如果方向信息重要，应使用 west 或 westward。
errors:eastward-used-for-westbound-trip.source: He flew to Seattle eastward for a business trip.
errors:eastward-used-for-westbound-trip.example: He flew to Seattle for a business trip.

errors:egg-plural-spelling-eggs-not-egge.title: egg 的复数拼写是 eggs
errors:egg-plural-spelling-eggs-not-egge.explanation: egg 的规则复数直接加 -s，写作 eggs；不要按类似 boxes 的模式写成 egges。
errors:egg-plural-spelling-eggs-not-egge.source: That's ok. First, I'll pour the coffee, then I'll serve the egges.
errors:egg-plural-spelling-eggs-not-egge.example: First, I'll pour the coffee, then I'll serve the eggs.

errors:embedded-what-clause-statement-wo.title: what 从句使用陈述语序
errors:embedded-what-clause-statement-wo.explanation: 在 what ... was like 等嵌入式从句中使用陈述语序，不能按直接疑问句倒装。
errors:embedded-what-clause-statement-wo.source: The old-timers in town still remember what here hadn't station was like.
errors:embedded-what-clause-statement-wo.example: The old-timers still remember what the town was like before it had a station.

errors:everyone-passport-plural-possessi.title: everyone 语境下护照误用单数 the passport
errors:everyone-passport-plural-possessi.explanation: everyone 指多个人，各自拥有护照时要写 their passports（复数），定冠词 the 会让读者以为只有一本共用护照。
errors:everyone-passport-plural-possessi.source: Please confirm everyone carries the passport before leaving.
errors:everyone-passport-plural-possessi.example: Please make sure everyone has their passports before leaving.

errors:existential-there-was-no.title: 用 there was no 表达过去不存在
errors:existential-there-was-no.explanation: 表示过去某地没有某物时，用 there was no + 单数名词；hadn't 不能直接放在地点词后表达存在。
errors:existential-there-was-no.source: The old-timers in town still remember what here hadn't station was like.
errors:existential-there-was-no.example: The old-timers remember when there was no station in the town.

errors:expensive-vs-expansive.title: expensive 与 expansive 词义不同，不能混用
errors:expensive-vs-expansive.explanation: expensive 表示价格高、昂贵；expansive 表示范围广阔、可扩展，几乎不用于价格语境。写价格时用 expensive / costly / high-priced，避免由发音相近推出的错误词形。
errors:expensive-vs-expansive.source: the most expansive things at later
errors:expensive-vs-expansive.example: The most expensive part comes later.

errors:fetch-use-get-not-take.title: 表示去取东西时用 get，不用 take
errors:fetch-use-get-not-take.explanation: 中文“去拿筷子/去拿东西”在英语里通常说 get the chopsticks 或 go and get the chopsticks；take 更强调把东西带走，不适合表达“去取来”。

errors:fill-out-form-not-fill-sheet.title: 填写表格用 fill out a form
errors:fill-out-form-not-fill-sheet.explanation: 英语里“填写表格”通常说 fill out a form 或 fill in a form；sheet 更偏一张纸或表单页，不是“表格任务”的自然搭配。
errors:fill-out-form-not-fill-sheet.source: please proceed to fill the sheet
errors:fill-out-form-not-fill-sheet.example: Please proceed to fill out the form.

errors:finite-verb-tense-agreement-in-em.title: 嵌入从句中的谓语动词仍需体现时态或主谓一致
errors:finite-verb-tense-agreement-in-em.explanation: 嵌入式从句虽然不用疑问倒装，但里面的谓语动词仍然要按语境使用正确的时态或主谓一致。过去叙述 She asked me... 中通常说 what the manager meant，而不是 what the manager mean。
errors:finite-verb-tense-agreement-in-em.source: She asked me what the manager mean by that comment.
errors:finite-verb-tense-agreement-in-em.example: She asked me what the manager meant by that comment.

errors:for-plus-base-verb-instead-of-to-.title: for + 动词原形（应为 to + 原形或 for + 动名词）
errors:for-plus-base-verb-instead-of-to-.explanation: for 是介词，后面只能接名词或动名词，不能接动词原形。表示“适合做某事”时用 to + 动词原形，或用 for + doing；两种结构不能混用。
errors:for-plus-base-verb-instead-of-to-.source: Lovely day for take the children to the zoo.
errors:for-plus-base-verb-instead-of-to-.example: Lovely day to take the children to the zoo, isn't it?

errors:for-the-first-time-expression.title: 用 for the first time 表示第一次做某事
errors:for-the-first-time-expression.explanation: 表示某次经历是第一次时，常把 for the first time 放在动作或句子的后部；if you first speak 容易被理解为“如果你先讲话”。
errors:for-the-first-time-expression.source: You may feels nervous if you first speak publicly.
errors:for-the-first-time-expression.example: You may feel nervous if you speak in public for the first time.

errors:formal-notice-avoid-contraction.title: 正式客户通知里说明「无法」要用 cannot，不用 can't
errors:formal-notice-avoid-contraction.explanation: 面向客户的正式通知属于书面正式语域，否定形式用 cannot；can't 会显得随意，且与同一段里的正式句式和被动语态不协调。
errors:formal-notice-avoid-contraction.source: The system can't restore the service and we will give the update tomorrow.
errors:formal-notice-avoid-contraction.example: The system cannot be restored this evening. We will provide an update before nine o'clock tomorrow morning.

errors:formal-text-avoid-contraction.title: 正式邮件和公告里不用 can't 这类缩略形式
errors:formal-text-avoid-contraction.explanation: can't 是口语缩略，正式邮件、公告、合同里语域不匹配，应写成 cannot 或 be unable to do；同时正式邮件句子里主宾位置要前置，不能把宾语提到句首再补 can't go。
errors:formal-text-avoid-contraction.source: I'm very sorry, the review meeting on Friday I can't go.
errors:formal-text-avoid-contraction.example: I regret that I am unable to attend the review meeting on Friday.

errors:friendly-service-not-very-good-se.title: friendly service 不等于 very good service
errors:friendly-service-not-very-good-se.explanation: 中文说“服务很友好”时，重点是服务人员态度亲切、友善，英文应明确用 friendly 或 the staff were friendly；very good service 只是泛泛评价服务好，遗漏了“友好”这一层语义。
errors:friendly-service-not-very-good-se.source: They served quickly last night and the service was very good.
errors:friendly-service-not-very-good-se.example: They served the dishes quickly last night, and the service was friendly.

errors:fruit-generic-uncountable-not-fru.title: 泛指水果时 fruit 通常不用复数
errors:fruit-generic-uncountable-not-fru.explanation: 表示水果这一类食物或不强调种类时，fruit 通常作不可数或集合名词使用；slice fruit 比 slice fruits 更自然。fruits 多用于强调不同种类的水果。
errors:fruit-generic-uncountable-not-fru.source: I'll make coffee while you slice fruits.
errors:fruit-generic-uncountable-not-fru.example: I'll make coffee while you slice the fruit.

errors:general-condition-if-present-simp.title: 一般情况的 if 从句用一般现在时
errors:general-condition-if-present-simp.explanation: 表达通常会怎样时，if 从句说一般条件，应用一般现在时 points out；过去式 pointed out 会让句子变成过去发生过的条件，和 usually 的习惯含义不匹配。
errors:general-condition-if-present-simp.source: I'll usually listen carefully if someone pointed out the problems in my english.
errors:general-condition-if-present-simp.example: I usually listen carefully if someone points out a problem with my English.

errors:get-promoted-past-participle.title: get + 过去分词表示被提拔，不能接动词原形
errors:get-promoted-past-participle.explanation: get 表示状态变化时后接过去分词，get promoted 才表示“被提拔”；get 后直接跟动词原形会让结构变成错误的主动形式。earn a promotion / be promoted 是更正式的表达。
errors:get-promoted-past-participle.source: In order to get promote, he comes at heavy price and almost miss the whole period of his daughter.
errors:get-promoted-past-participle.example: He worked overtime for months to get promoted ahead of schedule.

errors:go-ahead-northward-wrong-verb.title: “向北行进”应用 head/march northward，而非 go ahead northward
errors:go-ahead-northward-wrong-verb.explanation: go ahead 表“继续/着手进行”，不是“朝某方向行进”；向北行进应说 head northward 或 march northward。另注意 the team 作单数，动词用 goes。

errors:go-the-seaside-missing-to.title: go 后接地点漏掉 to
errors:go-the-seaside-missing-to.explanation: go 是不及物动词，接具体地点名词前要用 to：go to the seaside / go to the beach。go the seaside 缺少介词 to。
errors:go-the-seaside-missing-to.source: Lovely day to go the seaside, isn't it?
errors:go-the-seaside-missing-to.example: Lovely day to go to the beach, isn't it?

errors:go-to-bed-early-vs-sleep-early.title: “早点睡”应用 go to bed early/earlier，而非 sleep early
errors:go-to-bed-early-vs-sleep-early.explanation: “早点睡”更自然的英文是 go to bed early；对比常态时用比较级 earlier：go to bed earlier。sleep early 可理解但不够地道。
errors:go-to-bed-early-vs-sleep-early.source: I suggested that he sleep early.
errors:go-to-bed-early-vs-sleep-early.example: I suggested that he go to bed earlier.

errors:go-travel-to-redundant-verb-phras.title: go travel to 不自然，应选 go to 或 travel to
errors:go-travel-to-redundant-verb-phras.explanation: 表达去某地时，go to 和 travel to 都可以，但通常不要叠成 go travel to；应根据语气选择一个动词。
errors:go-travel-to-redundant-verb-phras.source: We will go travel to wengehua to visit our friends next year.
errors:go-travel-to-redundant-verb-phras.example: We will travel to Vancouver to visit our friends next year.

errors:graduate-from-institution-not-cit.title: graduate from 后接学校或机构，不接城市表示毕业地点
errors:graduate-from-institution-not-cit.explanation: graduate from 通常表示从某所学校或机构毕业；Seattle 是城市，不能直接表示毕业院校。若要表达从西雅图毕业的大学毕业，应说 graduate from a university in Seattle，或直接说 after graduating in Seattle。
errors:graduate-from-institution-not-cit.source: After graduating from Seattle, she moved eastward to New York.
errors:graduate-from-institution-not-cit.example: After graduating from a university in Seattle, she moved eastward to New York.

errors:grammar-spelling-grammer.title: grammar 拼写成 grammer
errors:grammar-spelling-grammer.explanation: grammar 的标准拼写是 grammar，中间是 ar，不是 er。grammer 通常会被看作拼写错误。

errors:grow-up-irregular-past-grew.title: grow up 的过去式是 grew up
errors:grow-up-irregular-past-grew.explanation: grow 是不规则动词，过去式为 grew，不是 growed；因此表示童年经历时应说 grew up。
errors:grow-up-irregular-past-grew.source: She lives in Yalisangna, bug she growed up back east.
errors:grow-up-irregular-past-grew.example: She lives in Arizona, but she grew up back east.

errors:half-an-hour-article.title: half an hour 需要不定冠词
errors:half-an-hour-article.explanation: 描述从过去开始、此刻仍在持续的天气过程时，has been drizzling 比 has drizzled 更自然，突出动作持续。
errors:half-an-hour-article.source: It has drizzled for half hour.
errors:half-an-hour-article.example: It has been drizzling for half an hour.

errors:hear-object-base-verb.title: hear + 宾格 + 动词原形
errors:hear-object-base-verb.explanation: hear 后面接人作宾语时要用宾格形式，再接动词原形表示听到某人做某事；应说 hear her talk，不说 hear she talk。
errors:hear-object-base-verb.source: That's great. I want to hear she talk about the main street in the past.
errors:hear-object-base-verb.example: That's great. I'd like to hear her talk about what Main Street was like in the past.

errors:help-yourself-reflexive-dropped-i.title: help yourself 是固定搭配，self 不能拆写
errors:help-yourself-reflexive-dropped-i.explanation: help yourself 作为固定表达要保持完整，不能写成 help your self。这里的 yourself 是一个整体反身代词，不是可拆开的两个词。
errors:help-yourself-reflexive-dropped-i.source: Help your self from the table.

errors:help-yourself-to-not-with-for-off.title: help yourself 后面常接 to，不是 with
errors:help-yourself-to-not-with-for-off.explanation: 在表示“请自取/随便吃”时，英语把被取用的东西看作一个可供取用的对象，所以习惯说 help yourself to + 食物/饮料，而不是 help yourself with。
errors:help-yourself-to-not-with-for-off.source: You can help yourself with some tea.
errors:help-yourself-to-not-with-for-off.example: You can help yourself to some tea.

errors:inform-is-verb-use-notification.title: inform 是动词，通知要用 notification / news
errors:inform-is-verb-use-notification.explanation: inform 只能作动词（inform somebody of something），名词要用 notification、news 或 information。
errors:inform-is-verb-use-notification.source: I received the inform of the pass
errors:inform-is-verb-use-notification.example: I got the news that I had passed the interview.

errors:information-uncountable-no-plural.title: information 是不可数名词，不能加复数 -s
errors:information-uncountable-no-plural.explanation: information 通常表示一类不可数的信息内容，不能直接写成 informations；需要表达具体条目时可说 pieces of information 或 items of information。
errors:information-uncountable-no-plural.source: After all the informations are confirmed, we'll proceed with your application.
errors:information-uncountable-no-plural.example: After all the information is confirmed, we'll proceed with your application.

errors:it-was-always-full-word-order.title: be 动词在 it was always full 中的位置
errors:it-was-always-full-word-order.explanation: 描述过去状态时，主语 it 后先接 be 动词 was，再用 always 修饰形容词 full；自然语序是 it was always full。
errors:it-was-always-full-word-order.source: I remember It always was full when the restaurant had just opened
errors:it-was-always-full-word-order.example: I remember it was always full when the restaurant had just opened.

errors:job-interview-not-interview-a-job.title: 面试一份工作用 have a job interview / interview for a job
errors:job-interview-not-interview-a-job.explanation: interview 作动词时宾语是“人”，不是“职位”；面试某份工作说 interview for a job，或直接用名词 have a job interview。
errors:job-interview-not-interview-a-job.example: I had a job interview on Monday.

errors:known-presentation-needs-definite.title: 已知演讲活动前需要 the
errors:known-presentation-needs-definite.explanation: 当 presentation 指双方都知道的那场演讲时，通常用 the presentation；continue with the presentation 表示继续这场演讲。
errors:known-presentation-needs-definite.source: After a ten-minute rest, we continued with presentation.
errors:known-presentation-needs-definite.example: After a ten-minute rest, we continued with the presentation.

errors:later-adverb-takes-no-at.title: later 单独作时间副词，不加介词 at
errors:later-adverb-takes-no-at.explanation: later 本身是时间副词，直接修饰动词或句子即可；at 只用于 at a later stage、at a later date 这类带名词的时间短语。

errors:launch-product-not-set-on-line.title: 上线产品用 launch / release，不用 set on line
errors:launch-product-not-set-on-line.explanation: set 表示“设置、放置”，产品上线用 launch、release、roll out；on line 不是英语里表示“上线”的说法。
errors:launch-product-not-set-on-line.source: We set the app on line on March
errors:launch-product-not-set-on-line.example: We launched the app in March.

errors:leave-vs-go-departure.title: 表“出发/离开”用 leave 比 go 更明确
errors:leave-vs-go-departure.explanation: 强调“比计划早点离开某地”时，用 leave a little bit earlier 语义最明确；go 也能表“去”，但在出发语境下不如 leave 贴切。
errors:leave-vs-go-departure.source: Can we go a little bit earlier?
errors:leave-vs-go-departure.example: Can we leave a little bit earlier?

errors:life-as-general-condition-without.title: life 表示生活状态时通常不用 the
errors:life-as-general-condition-without.explanation: life 表示一般的生活状态、生活方式时常作抽象名词使用，不需要 the；如果强调某一群人的生活，可以说 their life。
errors:life-as-general-condition-without.source: I wonder what the life was like before they moved Shanghai.
errors:life-as-general-condition-without.example: I wonder what their life was like before they moved to Shanghai.

errors:life-no-article-generic.title: 泛指 life 不加 the
errors:life-no-article-generic.explanation: 泛指「生活/人生」时 life 不加冠词，用 what life was like；the life 用于特指某段特定生活。
errors:life-no-article-generic.source: I wonder what the life was like before they moved to Shanghai.
errors:life-no-article-generic.example: I wonder what life was like before they moved to Shanghai.

errors:los-angeles-english-place-name.title: 洛杉矶的英文地名表达
errors:los-angeles-english-place-name.explanation: 中文地名“洛杉矶”在英语中应使用标准英文名 Los Angeles，不能按汉语拼音写成 luoshanji；专有名词的两个单词都要大写。
errors:los-angeles-english-place-name.source: She works in luoshanji, but she visits her parents back east every year.
errors:los-angeles-english-place-name.example: She works in Los Angeles, but she visits her parents back east every year.

errors:make-something-free-for-users.title: 对用户免费用 make it free for users
errors:make-something-free-for-users.explanation: free 是形容词，需要一个动词 make 才能带宾语；“对……免费”用 for + 人群，不用 to。
errors:make-something-free-for-users.source: then free it to all customer
errors:make-something-free-for-users.example: Then we made it free for all users.

errors:minute-spelling-in-duration-expre.title: minute 的拼写错误
errors:minute-spelling-in-duration-expre.explanation: 表示时间单位时，minute 的拼写中包含字母 u；minutes 不是 mibutes。
errors:minute-spelling-in-duration-expre.source: After ten mibutes of rest, he returned to work.
errors:minute-spelling-in-duration-expre.example: After ten minutes of rest, he returned to work.

errors:missing-article-before-countable-.title: 单数可数名词 presentation 前缺少限定词
errors:missing-article-before-countable-.explanation: presentation 作单数可数名词表示一次报告或演示时，通常需要 the、a、this、his 等限定词；直接说 in presentation 不自然。
errors:missing-article-before-countable-.source: The manager pointed out some problems in presentation and gave us some advice.
errors:missing-article-before-countable-.example: The manager pointed out some problems in the report and gave us some practical advice.

errors:missing-article-in-after-a-short-.title: after a short rest 中漏用冠词 a
errors:missing-article-in-after-a-short-.explanation: rest 作一次具体的休息时是可数名词，前面通常需要冠词或其他限定词，所以自然表达是 after a short rest，而不是 after short resting。
errors:missing-article-in-after-a-short-.source: After short resting, she continue with performing.
errors:missing-article-in-after-a-short-.example: After a short rest, she continued with her presentation.

errors:missing-article-or-possessive-bef.title: 单数可数名词 exam 前缺少限定词
errors:missing-article-or-possessive-bef.explanation: exam 是单数可数名词，普通陈述里通常需要 the、my、an 等限定词；表达第一次考试时，可以说 my first exam，也可以说 the exam the first time。
errors:missing-article-or-possessive-bef.source: I didn't pass exam first, but afterward I passed.
errors:missing-article-or-possessive-bef.example: I didn't pass my first exam, but later I passed.

errors:missing-be-before-located.title: located 作表语时不要漏掉 be 动词
errors:missing-be-before-located.explanation: located 是过去分词；表示某地或某机构位于某处时，通常使用 be located in/at，不能直接写主语加 located。
errors:missing-be-before-located.source: The company's headquarters located in Chicago, but it has several offices back east.
errors:missing-be-before-located.example: The company's headquarters is located in Chicago.

errors:missing-definite-article-before-s.title: 遗漏单数可数名词前的定冠词 the
errors:missing-definite-article-before-s.explanation: 上下文中已明确特指的单数可数名词（如 the manager、the new project）前需要用定冠词 the；中文没有冠词，所以容易漏掉。
errors:missing-definite-article-before-s.source: After manager approved, we proceeded with the budget and proceeded to handle new project.
errors:missing-definite-article-before-s.example: After the manager approved, we proceeded with the budget and proceeded to handle the new project.

errors:missing-finite-verb-after-subject.title: 英语完整句中主语短语后不能漏掉谓语动词
errors:missing-finite-verb-after-subject.explanation: 用户想表达“一阵凉爽的微风穿过花园”，但写成 A cool breeze through the garden after noon. 时，A cool breeze 只是主语名词短语，through the garden 是介词短语，整句缺少表示动作的谓语动词。完整句需要加入 blew、passed 或 drifted 等动词。
errors:missing-finite-verb-after-subject.source: A cool breeze through the garden after noon.
errors:missing-finite-verb-after-subject.example: A cool breeze blew through the garden in the afternoon.

errors:missing-past-perfect-for-earlier-.title: 过去参照点前的到达漏用过去完成时
errors:missing-past-perfect-for-earlier-.explanation: 当“到达”发生在另一个过去动作或说法之前时，英语用 had arrived / had just arrived 来标明先后顺序；只说 people from the big cities 会漏掉“刚来/已经来到”的动作关系。
errors:missing-past-perfect-for-earlier-.source: They say the word is used to the people from the big cities.
errors:missing-past-perfect-for-earlier-.example: They said the word was used to describe people who had just arrived from big cities.

errors:missing-third-person-s-after-she-.title: 一般现在时 she 后动词漏加 -s
errors:missing-third-person-s-after-she-.explanation: 主语是 she/he/it 或单数名词，并且句子描述通常情况时，谓语动词要用第三人称单数形式，例如 point out 变 points out，listen 变 listens。
errors:missing-third-person-s-after-she-.source: She politely point out a mistake on my email.
errors:missing-third-person-s-after-she-.example: She politely points out a spelling mistake in my email.

errors:misspelling-energy.title: energy 拼写错误（误写为 egegy）
errors:misspelling-energy.explanation: energy 正确拼写为 e-n-e-r-g-y。该词高频且拼写稳定，写错会破坏句子可读性，考试中属于可识别的低级失误。
errors:misspelling-energy.example: After a ten-minute rest, I regained my energy.

errors:misunderstand-go-out-with-as-lite.title: 误把 go out with someone 理解为字面外出
errors:misunderstand-go-out-with-as-lite.explanation: 在恋爱或嫉妒等语境中，go out with someone 通常表示和某人约会或谈恋爱，不能按字面理解为和某人出去或从某处出去。
errors:misunderstand-go-out-with-as-lite.source: 1. A; 2. 不是，表示从她办公室出去了
errors:misunderstand-go-out-with-as-lite.example: Tom got jealous because Lisa was going out with someone from her office.

errors:modal-verb-takes-base-form.title: 情态动词后接动词原形
errors:modal-verb-takes-base-form.explanation: could、can、must 等情态动词后面必须跟动词原形，不能用过去式；Could we leave… 才是正确的礼貌请求。
errors:modal-verb-takes-base-form.source: Could we left the hotel earlier.
errors:modal-verb-takes-base-form.example: Could we leave the hotel a little earlier than planned?

errors:modal-will-base-verb-not-s-form.title: will 后接动词原形
errors:modal-will-base-verb-not-s-form.explanation: 情态动词 will 后面接动词原形；主语即使是 that，也不要把后面的动词变成第三人称单数。
errors:modal-will-base-verb-not-s-form.source: He doesn't want to going out with his colleague, because that will makes work embarrassing.

errors:month-takes-in-not-on.title: 月份前的介词用 in 不用 on
errors:month-takes-in-not-on.explanation: 具体到月份（March、April）用 in March；on 只用于具体某一天（on March 3rd）。
errors:month-takes-in-not-on.example: We launched the app in March.

errors:move-to-place-preposition.title: move to + 地点：搬到某地
errors:move-to-place-preposition.explanation: 表示“搬到某地”时，move 后面接地点通常要用介词 to，不能直接说 move Shanghai。
errors:move-to-place-preposition.source: I wonder what the life was like before they moved Shanghai.
errors:move-to-place-preposition.example: I wonder what life was like before they moved to Shanghai.

errors:much-before-simple-adjective-cold.title: much 不能直接修饰普通形容词 cold
errors:much-before-simple-adjective-cold.explanation: much 通常修饰比较级、不可数名词或动词程度；普通形容词 cold 前更自然用 very、really、so 或 too。

errors:narrative-past-tense-consistency.title: 过去叙事中的时态不一致
errors:narrative-past-tense-consistency.explanation: 同一段已发生的连续事件应保持一般过去时；前句使用 read 表示过去时后，后句应使用 turned 和 followed。
errors:narrative-past-tense-consistency.source: After entering exhibit, they close their phone and follow guide
errors:narrative-past-tense-consistency.example: After entering the exhibition hall, they turned off their phones and followed the guide.

errors:need-practice-not-need-to-be-prac.title: 表达“需要练习”用 need practice / need to practice
errors:need-practice-not-need-to-be-prac.explanation: need to be practicing 表示结构混乱，be practicing 强调正在进行的动作，不适合表达能力还需要练习；更自然的是 My English still needs practice 或 I still need to practice my English。
errors:need-practice-not-need-to-be-prac.source: My English still need to be practicing.
errors:need-practice-not-need-to-be-prac.example: I still need to practice my English.

errors:next-day-no-preposition-on.title: the next day 前不加 on
errors:next-day-no-preposition-on.explanation: the next day / the following day 本身已是时间状语，不能再加 on；on 只和具体日期或星期搭配。
errors:next-day-no-preposition-on.example: I got the offer the next day.

errors:no-definite-article-before-generi.title: from A to B 表示范围时两侧类别名词不加定冠词
errors:no-definite-article-before-generi.explanation: from climate to education 表达的是“从气候到教育”这类话题类别跨度，属于泛指，两侧名词用零冠词；加了 the 表示特指某一个已知的气候或某一项具体的教育事务，语义跑偏。同类：from beginner to advanced、from design to delivery。
errors:no-definite-article-before-generi.source: from the climate to the education
errors:no-definite-article-before-generi.example: The report covers a wide range of topics, from climate to education.

errors:no-preposition-before-out-west.title: out west / back east 前不加介词
errors:no-preposition-before-out-west.explanation: out west 和 back east 是方向副词短语，前面不需要 in/to；说 live out west、move out west。对比：live in the West（名词需 in + the）。
errors:no-preposition-before-out-west.source: She now lives in out west.

errors:not-sure-how-to-pronounce-for-unc.title: 用 not sure how to pronounce 表达不确定读音
errors:not-sure-how-to-pronounce-for-unc.explanation: 表示自己不知道某个名称怎么读时，I’m not sure how to pronounce... 比 I can’t confirm the correct pronunciation... 更直接自然；confirm 通常表示核实信息，而不是单纯不确定。
errors:not-sure-how-to-pronounce-for-unc.source: I can't confirm the correct pronunciation of the word.
errors:not-sure-how-to-pronounce-for-unc.example: I’m not sure how to pronounce this name.

errors:note-that-vs-notice.title: 正式通知用 please note that，不用 please notice that
errors:note-that-vs-notice.explanation: note 作动词表示「留意、注意」，固定说法是 please note that…；notice 作动词强调「注意到（看到、察觉）」，不用于正式通知开头的提醒句式。
errors:note-that-vs-notice.source: Please notice that late submissions can not be accepted after 5 pm.
errors:note-that-vs-notice.example: Please note that the office closes at five.

errors:nurse-agreement-and-checkup-collo.title: 第三人称单数与 checkup 搭配
errors:nurse-agreement-and-checkup-collo.explanation: 一般现在时主语 the nurse 是第三人称单数，accompany 要加 -s；表示去做检查时，go for a checkup 或 accompany someone to an examination 比 do check 更自然。
errors:nurse-agreement-and-checkup-collo.source: The nurse accompany the elder to do check.
errors:nurse-agreement-and-checkup-collo.example: The nurse accompanies the elderly man to his checkup.

errors:omit-be-in-passive-after-confirme.title: 被动从句中省略 be 动词
errors:omit-be-in-passive-after-confirme.explanation: 当主语是 documents、information、payment 这类被确认的对象时，confirmed 是过去分词，需要和 be 动词组成被动结构，如 are confirmed 或 is confirmed。
errors:omit-be-in-passive-after-confirme.source: We will proceed with your application after all the documents confirmed.
errors:omit-be-in-passive-after-confirme.example: We will proceed with your application after all the documents are confirmed.

errors:omitting-location-in-existential-.title: there was no 句子漏掉地点范围
errors:omitting-location-in-existential-.explanation: 把“某地没有某物”翻译成 there was no... 时，通常需要保留 in/at + 地点来说明不存在发生在哪个范围内；只说 there was no train station ten years ago 会让听者不知道是哪里没有火车站。
errors:omitting-location-in-existential-.source: There was no train station ten years ago.
errors:omitting-location-in-existential-.example: There was no train station in the town ten years ago.

errors:on-the-way-used-for-along-this-ro.title: 把 on the way 误当作 along this road
errors:on-the-way-used-for-along-this-ro.explanation: on the way 通常表示“在去某地的路上/途中”，不等于“沿着这条路继续走”。表达路线指引时，应说 continue on this road 或 continue along this road。
errors:on-the-way-used-for-along-this-ro.source: Continue on the way until you see a bank.
errors:on-the-way-used-for-along-this-ro.example: Continue on this road until you see a bank.

errors:opened-not-closed-for-opening-eve.title: 表达刚开业时误用 closed
errors:opened-not-closed-for-opening-eve.explanation: 描述店铺、图书馆或车站“刚开业/刚开放”时，英语要用 opened 或 had just opened；closed 表示关闭、停业，方向相反。
errors:opened-not-closed-for-opening-eve.source: Local residents still remember when the new library had just closed.
errors:opened-not-closed-for-opening-eve.example: Local residents still remember when the new library had just opened.

errors:opened-spelling-past-participle.title: opened 的过去式和过去分词拼写
errors:opened-spelling-past-participle.explanation: open 的过去式和过去分词是 opened，拼写中包含 e 和 d，不能写成 opend。
errors:opened-spelling-past-participle.source: I visited the bookstore when it had just opend.
errors:opened-spelling-past-participle.example: I visited the bookstore when it had just opened.

errors:opening-event-uses-opened-not-clo.title: 描述开业事件使用 opened
errors:opening-event-uses-opened-not-clo.explanation: 表示剧院、电影院或书店开始营业，要用 open 的过去式或过去分词 opened；close 表示关闭，语义方向相反。had just 后面还需要过去分词，因此应说 had just opened。
errors:opening-event-uses-opened-not-clo.source: People still remember when the cinema had just close.
errors:opening-event-uses-opened-not-clo.example: People still remember when the cinema had just opened.

errors:passive-clause-needs-be.title: proceed with 与被动从句的完整结构
errors:passive-clause-needs-be.explanation: 表示继续办理某件事情时用 proceed with + 名词，如 proceed with your application；从句里 information 是 confirm 的承受者，因此应写 after all the information is confirmed，不能省略被动语态里的 is。
errors:passive-clause-needs-be.source: We will continue on your applications after all information confirmed.
errors:passive-clause-needs-be.example: We will proceed with your application after all the information is confirmed.

errors:past-narrative-main-verb-tense.title: 过去叙事中用 welcomed 和 arrived from
errors:past-narrative-main-verb-tense.explanation: 叙述已经发生的欢迎动作时，主句谓语应使用一般过去时 welcomed；表达从某地抵达时用 arrive from + 出发地，因此应说 had just arrived from Boston，而不是 arrived in Boston。
errors:past-narrative-main-verb-tense.source: They welcome the traveler who had just arrived in Boston.
errors:past-narrative-main-verb-tense.example: They welcomed the traveler who had just arrived from Boston.

errors:past-narrative-main-verb-tense-sh.title: 过去叙事中主句动词误用现在时
errors:past-narrative-main-verb-tense-sh.explanation: 叙述已经发生的一连串动作时，主要动作通常保持过去时；We talked ... and then decide ... 中 decide 应与 talked 对齐为 decided。
errors:past-narrative-main-verb-tense-sh.source: We talked about the price first, and then decide to talk about the details next week.
errors:past-narrative-main-verb-tense-sh.example: We talked about the price first, and then decided to talk about the details next week.

errors:past-narrative-tense-consistency.title: 过去叙事中并列谓语保持过去时
errors:past-narrative-tense-consistency.explanation: 句子前半用一般过去时叙述已发生的事，后面的并列动词也应用过去式，miss 与 comes 都应改为过去形式，否则时态错位。
errors:past-narrative-tense-consistency.source: he comes at heavy price and almost miss the whole period of his daughter
errors:past-narrative-tense-consistency.example: He paid a heavy price for the promotion and almost missed his daughter's entire childhood.

errors:past-perfect-requires-past-partic.title: 过去完成时使用过去分词
errors:past-perfect-requires-past-partic.explanation: 过去完成时结构是 had + 过去分词；fly 的过去式是 flew，过去分词是 flown，因此应说 had flown。
errors:past-perfect-requires-past-partic.source: She was nervous because she had never flew on a plane before that trip.
errors:past-perfect-requires-past-partic.example: She was nervous because she had never flown on a plane before that trip.

errors:past-tense-after-after-clause.title: after 从句中的过去时
errors:past-tense-after-after-clause.explanation: 叙述过去发生的动作时，after 引导的从句使用一般过去时；dish up 的过去式是 dished up。
errors:past-tense-after-after-clause.source: After the chef dish up the dishes, he plated it with some fresh herbs.
errors:past-tense-after-after-clause.example: After the chef dished up the vegetables, he plated them with fresh herbs.

errors:past-tense-in-completed-event-seq.title: 已完成的过去事件序列使用一般过去时
errors:past-tense-in-completed-event-seq.explanation: 叙述已经发生并完成的一连串动作时，时间从句和主句通常都用一般过去时。
errors:past-tense-in-completed-event-seq.source: I called my sister as soon as I hear the message.
errors:past-tense-in-completed-event-seq.example: I called my sister as soon as I heard the news.

errors:past-tense-needed-in-reported-cla.title: 转述句中的过去叙述动词要用过去式
errors:past-tense-needed-in-reported-cla.explanation: 在过去时背景下，像 She wonder 这样的叙述动词也要变成 wondered。英语会把这类转述背景当作已经发生的动作处理，所以动词形式要跟着时间线走。
errors:past-tense-needed-in-reported-cla.source: She wonder if the suggest adopted to all students.
errors:past-tense-needed-in-reported-cla.example: She wondered whether the advice applied to all students.

errors:past-tense-parallel-after-and-the.title: 过去时并列动作中漏用过去式
errors:past-tense-parallel-after-and-the.explanation: 叙述过去连续动作时，如果前一个动词用 plated，后面的并列动作也通常用过去式 added，保持时间线一致。
errors:past-tense-parallel-after-and-the.source: The chef plated the beef and then add a little sauce.
errors:past-tense-parallel-after-and-the.example: The chef plated the steak and then added a little sauce.

errors:past-tense-verb-form-for-past-tim.title: 过去时间语境仍用动词原形
errors:past-tense-verb-form-for-past-tim.explanation: 句子用 after the holidays、after lunch 明确指向过去，主句谓语必须用一般过去时，不能保留原形 proceed。
errors:past-tense-verb-form-for-past-tim.source: The board proceed with working on the merger plan after the holidays. / We proceed with the rest proposal after lunch.
errors:past-tense-verb-form-for-past-tim.example: The board proceeded with the merger plan after the holidays.

errors:past-tense-with-finished-past-tim.title: 明确的过去时间通常搭配一般过去时
errors:past-tense-with-finished-past-tim.explanation: yesterday morning 指已经结束的过去时间，描述当时发生的动作应使用一般过去时 waited，而不是现在进行时 are waiting。
errors:past-tense-with-finished-past-tim.source: A group of students are waiting outside the library yesterday morning.
errors:past-tense-with-finished-past-tim.example: A group of students waited outside the library yesterday morning.

errors:past-time-marker-last-night-omitt.title: 翻译过去时间时不要漏掉 last night 和过去时
errors:past-time-marker-last-night-omitt.explanation: 中文里有“昨晚”时，英文通常需要明确加 last night，并把主要谓语放到过去时；只说 is very good 会变成现在的一般评价，遗漏了原句的具体过去时间。
errors:past-time-marker-last-night-omitt.source: That restaurant's service is very good and they serve dishes quickly.
errors:past-time-marker-last-night-omitt.example: The service at that restaurant was very good last night, and they served the dishes quickly.

errors:past-time-used-to-live-present-er.title: 以前住在 back east 的时态和介词
errors:past-time-used-to-live-present-er.explanation: 中文“以前住在”强调过去的居住情况，英语通常用 lived 或 used to live；back east 本身常作地点副词短语，直接跟在 live、move、come from 等动词后，不再加 in。
errors:past-time-used-to-live-present-er.source: My grandparents live in back east.
errors:past-time-used-to-live-present-er.example: My grandparents used to live back east.

errors:phone-on-silent-not-turn-down.title: 把手机调成静音不能直接说 turn down phones
errors:phone-on-silent-not-turn-down.explanation: turn down 表示把音量调低，不等于把手机设为静音；表达“调成静音”通常说 put/switch/set phones on silent。
errors:phone-on-silent-not-turn-down.source: Please turn down your phones before starting meeting.
errors:phone-on-silent-not-turn-down.example: Please put your phones on silent before starting the meeting.

errors:phrase-mistranslated-as-word.title: 把 phrase 误译成 word
errors:phrase-mistranslated-as-word.explanation: phrase 是短语，word 是单词；中文提示说“这个短语”时，英文应说 this phrase，而不是 this word。
errors:phrase-mistranslated-as-word.source: Now, this word is often used in informal situation.
errors:phrase-mistranslated-as-word.example: Now, this phrase is often used in informal situations.

errors:plate-x-with-y-garnish.title: plate X with Y：摆盘并加点缀
errors:plate-x-with-y-garnish.explanation: plate 作动词表示把食物摆盘；若要说明点缀物，用 plate 某食物 with 点缀物（如 with Parmesan cheese），不要写成 covered the cheek——cheek 是脸颊，cheese 才是奶酪。
errors:plate-x-with-y-garnish.source: He plated the pasta and covered the cheek.
errors:plate-x-with-y-garnish.example: He plated the pasta with Parmesan cheese.

errors:plural-grandparents-translation.title: grandparents 的复数对应
errors:plural-grandparents-translation.explanation: 中文“祖父母”通常对应复数 grandparents；描述两位祖辈时不能使用单数 grandparent。
errors:plural-grandparents-translation.source: My grandparent comes from back east, but living in ...
errors:plural-grandparents-translation.example: My grandparents came from back east.

errors:plural-phones-after-phone-shared-.title: phone 语境里常用复数
errors:plural-phones-after-phone-shared-.explanation: 这里说的是导览前大家各自关闭手机，通常写 their phones 更自然；单数 phone 会让句子像只关一部手机。
errors:plural-phones-after-phone-shared-.example: They turned off their phones before the tour began.

errors:point-out-used-with-advice-colloc.title: 把 point out 和 advice 直接搭配
errors:point-out-used-with-advice-colloc.explanation: point out 通常表示指出事实、问题、错误或需要注意的地方；advice 是建议内容，更自然的动词是 give、offer 或 provide，若用 suggest 则后面通常接做法或 that 从句。
errors:point-out-used-with-advice-colloc.source: She usually points out useful advice in meeting.
errors:point-out-used-with-advice-colloc.example: She usually offers useful advice in meetings.

errors:pointed-out-past-tense.title: “指出了”应用过去式 pointed out
errors:pointed-out-past-tense.explanation: “老师指出了……”描述过去完成的动作，应用过去式 pointed out；现在时 points out 表示一般习惯，不符合句意。
errors:pointed-out-past-tense.source: My teacher points out some problems in my writing.
errors:pointed-out-past-tense.example: My teacher pointed out several problems in my essay.

errors:possessive-daughter-childhood.title: “某人的整个童年”用名词所有格，不用 of 结构硬译
errors:possessive-daughter-childhood.explanation: 英语中表达人与其人生阶段的所属关系时，通常用名词所有格 his daughter's childhood；the whole period of his daughter 会读成“女儿的某段时期”，且语义含糊。
errors:possessive-daughter-childhood.source: almost miss the whole period of his daughter
errors:possessive-daughter-childhood.example: He almost missed his daughter's whole childhood.

errors:postmodifier-object-topicalizatio.title: 不定式后置修饰的名词短语不能前置成话题再用 it 重复
errors:postmodifier-object-topicalizatio.explanation: 英语不把带后置修饰的名词短语直接搬到句首当话题，再用代词回指。要表达“还有做不完的活”，用 there be 结构：There is work to do that I cannot finish now；或保持正常语序：I cannot finish the work I have to do now。
errors:postmodifier-object-topicalizatio.source: The work to do I can't do it now.
errors:postmodifier-object-topicalizatio.example: There is a lot of work to do that I cannot finish today.

errors:preposition-before-directional-ad.title: back east / out west 前不要加 in
errors:preposition-before-directional-ad.explanation: back east 和 out west 在句中常作地点副词短语，直接修饰 live、move、grow up 等动词；不能按中文“在东部/在西部”的直觉再加 in。
errors:preposition-before-directional-ad.source: She lived in back east when she was a baby and now she lives in out west.
errors:preposition-before-directional-ad.example: She lived back east when she was little, and now she lives out west.

errors:present-habit-when-clause-past-te.title: 现在习惯句中 when 从句误用过去时
errors:present-habit-when-clause-past-te.explanation: 描述现在经常发生的习惯时，主句用 always + 一般现在时，when 从句也通常用一般现在时表示同类情境；pointed out 会把动作拉回过去某一次，和 she can’t take it 的现在习惯不匹配。
errors:present-habit-when-clause-past-te.source: She always dishes out presentations of others, but she can’t take it when others pointed out her mistakes.
errors:present-habit-when-clause-past-te.example: She always dishes it out about other people’s reports, but she can’t take it when others point out her mistakes.

errors:present-perfect-missing-has-and-o.title: 现在完成时漏掉 has 和宾语：he done many times
errors:present-perfect-missing-has-and-o.explanation: 说“做过很多次”是持续到现在之前的经历，要用 have/has + done 的现在完成时，并且 do 是及物动词，必须带宾语 it/this。
errors:present-perfect-missing-has-and-o.example: He has done it many times.

errors:present-simple-for-future-arrange.title: 将来仍会做某事要用 will，不用一般现在时
errors:present-simple-for-future-arrange.explanation: 句子谈的是下周的将来安排，「仍然会……」必须用 will + 动词原形；直接写 still continue 会读成恒常习惯，与上文「推迟到下周」的时间框架对不上。
errors:present-simple-for-future-arrange.source: we still continue with the plan
errors:present-simple-for-future-arrange.example: We will still proceed with the renovation next week.（下周我们仍会推进这次改造）

errors:presentation-not-representation-f.title: 汇报场景使用 presentation
errors:presentation-not-representation-f.explanation: presentation 表示演示、汇报或演讲；representation 通常表示代表、表现形式或代理，不用于这里的课堂/工作汇报。
errors:presentation-not-representation-f.source: After resting for a few minutes, he continued with his representation.
errors:presentation-not-representation-f.example: After resting for a few minutes, he continued with his presentation.

errors:preserve-name-vs-word-in-translat.title: 翻译时区分 name 与 word
errors:preserve-name-vs-word-in-translat.explanation: name 指人名、地名或名称，word 指一般词语；原文说“这个名字”时应保留为 this name。
errors:preserve-name-vs-word-in-translat.source: I can't confirm the correct pronunciation of the word.
errors:preserve-name-vs-word-in-translat.example: I’m not sure of the correct pronunciation of this name.

errors:preserve-number-in-translation.title: 翻译时保持原句数量信息
errors:preserve-number-in-translation.explanation: 中文的“十五分钟”必须对应 fifteen minutes 或 a fifteen-minute，不能改成 ten-minute；数量信息也是句意的一部分。
errors:preserve-number-in-translation.source: She needs a ten-minute rest to regain her concentration.
errors:preserve-number-in-translation.example: She needs a fifteen-minute rest to regain her concentration.

errors:preserve-pronoun-gender-in-transl.title: 翻译时保持人称代词性别一致
errors:preserve-pronoun-gender-in-transl.explanation: 中文原文指女性时，宾格应使用 her，不能换成表示男性的 him。翻译需要保持指代对象一致。
errors:preserve-pronoun-gender-in-transl.source: I called him on the way to the airport.
errors:preserve-pronoun-gender-in-transl.example: I called her on the way to the airport.

errors:problem-with-pronunciation-colloc.title: 用 problem with ... 表达某方面的问题
errors:problem-with-pronunciation-colloc.explanation: point out 后面可以接具体错误；说某方面有问题时，英语更自然用 a problem with my pronunciation，而不是直接说 my pronunciation problem。
errors:problem-with-pronunciation-colloc.source: My teacher pointed out my pronunciation problem after class.
errors:problem-with-pronunciation-colloc.example: My teacher pointed out a problem with my pronunciation after class.

errors:proceed-needs-preposition-before-.title: proceed 后接名词时通常需要介词
errors:proceed-needs-preposition-before-.explanation: proceed 通常不是直接及物动词，不能自然说 proceed the plan；如果后面是名词，常用 proceed with the plan，表示继续推进这件事。
errors:proceed-needs-preposition-before-.source: Once the contract was signed, the team proceeded the implementation plan.
errors:proceed-needs-preposition-before-.example: Once the contract was signed, the team proceeded with the implementation plan.

errors:proceed-not-followed-by-gerund.title: proceed 后不接动名词
errors:proceed-not-followed-by-gerund.explanation: proceed 表示“继续前行”时是不及物动词，不能直接接 driving 这类动名词；可说 you may proceed，或用 proceed through/to + 名词。
errors:proceed-not-followed-by-gerund.source: The light is green, so you may proceed driving.
errors:proceed-not-followed-by-gerund.example: The light is green, so you may proceed through the intersection.

errors:proceed-to-infinitive.title: proceed to 后接动词原形
errors:proceed-to-infinitive.explanation: 表示“接着做下一件事”时使用 proceed to + 动词原形，不能直接把动词接在 proceed 后面。
errors:proceed-to-infinitive.source: Once your name is called, please proceed enter the interview room.
errors:proceed-to-infinitive.example: Once your name is called, please proceed to enter the interview room.

errors:proceed-with-formal-plan-advance.title: 推进计划用 proceed with，语域比 continue with 正式
errors:proceed-with-formal-plan-advance.explanation: proceed with + 事情或计划 用于正式公告与流程说明，表示按既定方案继续推进，语域明显比 continue with 正式；中文里的「这次改造」也要译出具体对象，不能泛化成 the plan。
errors:proceed-with-formal-plan-advance.source: The meeting is deferred to next week, but we still continue with the plan.
errors:proceed-with-formal-plan-advance.example: The meeting has been put off until next week, but we will still proceed with the renovation as planned.（会议推迟到下周，但我们仍会按原计划推进这次改造）

errors:proceed-with-gerund-vs-proceed-to.title: proceed with doing 与 proceed to do 的语义差别
errors:proceed-with-gerund-vs-proceed-to.explanation: proceed to do 表示接下来开始做另一件事；proceed with 后面更自然接名词，表示继续推进某项已有事务。把 After the meeting, we proceeded with discussing the budget 写成 proceed to discuss the budget 更自然。
errors:proceed-with-gerund-vs-proceed-to.source: After the meeting, we proceeded with discussing the budget.
errors:proceed-with-gerund-vs-proceed-to.example: After the meeting, we proceeded to discuss the budget.

errors:pronoun-agreement-he-she.title: 主语代词前后一致
errors:pronoun-agreement-he-she.explanation: 句子已经用 He 作主语，后面的谓语也应继续用 he；不能在同一个主语链中无理由切换成 she。
errors:pronoun-agreement-he-she.source: He comes from back east and now she works in California.
errors:pronoun-agreement-he-she.example: He comes from back east and now works in California.

errors:pronoun-agreement-with-female-nam.title: 女性人名代词误用 he/him
errors:pronoun-agreement-with-female-nam.explanation: Mia 是女性名时，后文代词应保持一致，用 she/her；不能换成 he/him。
errors:pronoun-agreement-with-female-nam.source: but he can't take it when people accuse him
errors:pronoun-agreement-with-female-nam.example: but she can’t take it when people correct her.

errors:pronunciation-vs-voice-for-accent.title: 把“发音”误写成 voice
errors:pronunciation-vs-voice-for-accent.explanation: 说某人的发音或读音时通常用 pronunciation；voice 指嗓音、声音特质，不等于 pronunciation。
errors:pronunciation-vs-voice-for-accent.source: Mia always dishes out others voice
errors:pronunciation-vs-voice-for-accent.example: Mia always makes fun of other people’s pronunciation.

errors:purpose-infinitive-not-for-verb.title: 表示目的用不定式 to do，不用 for + 动词原形
errors:purpose-infinitive-not-for-verb.explanation: 表达“为了做某事”时，英语用 to + 动词原形作目的状语；for 后面只能接名词或动名词，接动词原形会破坏结构。原句本来已有正确的 to catch，不需要改成 for catch。
errors:purpose-infinitive-not-for-verb.source: She left the hotel at dawn for catch the first bus.
errors:purpose-infinitive-not-for-verb.example: She left the hotel at dawn to catch the first bus.

errors:recruit-noun-vs-recruitment.title: recruit 作名词指新人，招聘用 recruitment
errors:recruit-noun-vs-recruitment.explanation: recruit 作名词指“被招募的新人”，表示招聘这项工作或流程要用不可数名词 recruitment（美式也常用 hiring）。
errors:recruit-noun-vs-recruitment.example: It is responsible for recruitment decisions.

errors:redundant-repeated-then.title: 同一串动作里不必反复用 then
errors:redundant-repeated-then.explanation: then 的作用是一次性标记先后关系，连续两个分句都加 then 会造成冗余；只保留一个 then，或用 after doing 改写。
errors:redundant-repeated-then.source: and then we checked in and then went out for dinner
errors:redundant-repeated-then.example: , and then we checked in and went out for dinner.

errors:refrigerator-spelling-not-refrige.title: refrigerator 的拼写：不要写成 refrigerater
errors:refrigerator-spelling-not-refrige.explanation: refrigerator 表示冰箱，结尾是 -ator，不是 -ater。日常口语里也常用 fridge。
errors:refrigerator-spelling-not-refrige.example: There are some drinks in the refrigerator.

errors:regain-again-redundancy.title: regain 与 again 语义重复
errors:regain-again-redundancy.explanation: regain 本身已含"重新获得、恢复"（get back）之意，再加 again 造成语义冗余，应删去 again。
errors:regain-again-redundancy.example: After a ten-minute rest, I regained my energy.

errors:regain-concentration-collocation.title: 恢复注意力的自然搭配
errors:regain-concentration-collocation.explanation: 表示重新集中注意力，英语更常用 regain her concentration、refocus 或 get her focus back；restore attention 不是这里的自然搭配。
errors:regain-concentration-collocation.source: After five-minute rest, she restored attention.
errors:regain-concentration-collocation.example: After a five-minute rest, she regained her concentration.

errors:registration-vs-register-noun-eve.title: 把 registration 误写成 register
errors:registration-vs-register-noun-eve.explanation: register 作名词多指登记簿、注册表或收银机；表示“注册/登记这个流程完成”时应使用 registration，或直接说 after completing registration。
errors:registration-vs-register-noun-eve.example: After registration is complete, please proceed to fill out the form.

errors:relative-clause-after-friend-live.title: 用定语从句或现在分词修饰 friend
errors:relative-clause-after-friend-live.explanation: 修饰 a friend 时，不能直接说 a friend lived near；应使用定语从句 a friend who lives nearby，或现在分词短语 a friend living nearby。
errors:relative-clause-after-friend-live.source: I am waiting for a friend lived near.
errors:relative-clause-after-friend-live.example: I am waiting for a friend who lives nearby.

errors:remaining-vs-rest-noun-phrase.title: 剩下的提案误用 the rest proposal
errors:remaining-vs-rest-noun-phrase.explanation: rest 作“其余部分”时通常接 of 短语或单独使用，直接修饰名词要用 remaining，且剩余多份提案需用复数。
errors:remaining-vs-rest-noun-phrase.source: We proceed with the rest proposal after lunch.
errors:remaining-vs-rest-noun-phrase.example: We proceeded with the remaining proposals after lunch.

errors:remember-when-past-state-was-not-.title: remember when 中过去状态的时态
errors:remember-when-past-state-was-not-.explanation: 在 remember when ... 表示“记得过去某个时候/过去某种状态”时，从句通常用过去时；描述河以前很干净，应说 the river was very clean 或 the river used to be very clean，而不是 is very clean.
errors:remember-when-past-state-was-not-.source: The old-timers in the village still remember when the river is very clean.
errors:remember-when-past-state-was-not-.example: The old-timers in the village still remember when the river was very clean.

errors:restaurant-branches-not-offices.title: 餐厅分店不自然说 offices
errors:restaurant-branches-not-offices.explanation: office 通常指办公室或公司办事处；餐厅、商店等面向顾客的分店更自然说 branch、location 或 outlet。因此“这家餐厅有几个分店”应说 several branches/locations/outlets。
errors:restaurant-branches-not-offices.source: The restaurant has several offices, but the headquarters is in Shanghai.
errors:restaurant-branches-not-offices.example: The restaurant has several branches, but its headquarters is in Shanghai.

errors:review-status-under-review-vs-pro.title: under review 不用进行时误写
errors:review-status-under-review-vs-pro.explanation: 表示“正在审查中”时，英语里常用固定短语 under review，而不是用 reviewing 来表达状态。reviewing 更像“正在复习/审查动作本身”，不适合替代这个结果状态。
errors:review-status-under-review-vs-pro.example: The application is still under review.

errors:safety-training-not-safety-train.title: 培训误写成 safety train
errors:safety-training-not-safety-train.explanation: train 是交通工具或动词“训练”，表示“培训活动”的名词是 training，需要 training 的派生形式。
errors:safety-training-not-safety-train.source: The safety train in the morning has finished
errors:safety-training-not-safety-train.example: The safety training this morning is over.

errors:semantic-conflict-old-timers-newc.title: old-timers 与 newcomer 语义冲突
errors:semantic-conflict-old-timers-newc.explanation: old-timers 指长期生活在某地、熟悉当地往事的人，不能和 moved here last week / know nothing about the town 这类新来且不了解当地的描述搭配；这种语境应改用 newcomers 或 new residents。
errors:semantic-conflict-old-timers-newc.source: Many old-timers moved here last week and know nothing about the town.
errors:semantic-conflict-old-timers-newc.example: Many newcomers moved here last week and know nothing about the town.

errors:serving-hours-rendered-with-open.title: 用 open 表达「供应/营业时间」
errors:serving-hours-rendered-with-open.explanation: open 说明的是「店铺开门、营业」，不能带出「供应早餐」这件事；要表达「早餐从七点供应到十点」，动作主体应落在 serve 上，用 breakfast is served from ... to ... 或 the café serves breakfast from ... to ...。
errors:serving-hours-rendered-with-open.source: the breakfast open from seven am to ten pm.
errors:serving-hours-rendered-with-open.example: Breakfast is served from seven to ten.

errors:set-the-table-not-put-the-table.title: set the table：摆好餐桌
errors:set-the-table-not-put-the-table.explanation: 表示吃饭前摆放餐具、布置餐桌时，英语固定说 set the table；put the table 会被理解成“放置桌子”这个家具，不能表达摆餐具。
errors:set-the-table-not-put-the-table.source: Could you dish it up while I put the table?
errors:set-the-table-not-put-the-table.example: Could you dish it up while I set the table?

errors:several-plus-plural-count-noun.title: several 后接可数名词复数
errors:several-plus-plural-count-noun.explanation: several 表示“几个”，后面接可数名词复数；因此应说 several offices，而不是 several office。
errors:several-plus-plural-count-noun.source: The company has several office in the east, but the head is in Chigaco.
errors:several-plus-plural-count-noun.example: The company has several offices in the East.

errors:short-rest-not-short-resting.title: 休息一会儿用 a short rest
errors:short-rest-not-short-resting.explanation: 表示一次短暂休息时，使用可数名词短语 a short rest；short resting 不是自然的名词表达。
errors:short-rest-not-short-resting.source: After short resting, the students continued with group representation.
errors:short-rest-not-short-resting.example: After a short rest, the students continued with their group presentation.

errors:sign-mistaken-for-brand.title: sign 误用为 brand
errors:sign-mistaken-for-brand.explanation: 表达“品牌”用 brand；sign 指“标牌/招牌/标识”，如 a store sign。the name of the sign 不符合原意，应为 this brand's name 或 the name of this brand。
errors:sign-mistaken-for-brand.source: I'm not sure how to pronounce this name of the sign.
errors:sign-mistaken-for-brand.example: I'm not sure how to pronounce this brand's name.

errors:simple-past-fall-without-be-auxil.title: 一般过去时 fell 前不加 be 动词
errors:simple-past-fall-without-be-auxil.explanation: fall 是实义动词，其一般过去式 fell 可以独立作谓语；不能用 was ... fall 拼成过去时。
errors:simple-past-fall-without-be-auxil.source: Heavy rain was throughout the night fall.
errors:simple-past-fall-without-be-auxil.example: Heavy rain fell throughout the night.

errors:singular-application-mistaken-as-.title: 把单数“申请”误写成复数 applications
errors:singular-application-mistaken-as-.explanation: 中文“我的申请”通常指一份申请材料，英文应使用单数 application，并搭配 is still under review。只有明确有多份申请时才用 applications are。
errors:singular-application-mistaken-as-.source: My applications are still under review.
errors:singular-application-mistaken-as-.example: My application is still under review.

errors:singular-count-noun-missing-artic.title: 单数可数名词前遗漏限定词
errors:singular-count-noun-missing-artic.explanation: museum、guide 等单数可数名词通常不能裸用，需要根据语境添加 a、the 或其他限定词。
errors:singular-count-noun-missing-artic.source: Students carefully read safety requirements before visiting museum. After entering exhibit, they close their phone and follow guide to get the history this city.
errors:singular-count-noun-missing-artic.example: Before visiting the museum, the students read the safety instructions.

errors:singular-countable-rest-needs-art.title: 单数可数的 rest 前缺少限定词
errors:singular-countable-rest-needs-art.explanation: rest 表示一次具体的休息时，通常是可数名词，需要 a/an 或其他限定词；因此应说 a ten-minute rest，而不能直接说 ten-minute rest。
errors:singular-countable-rest-needs-art.source: She needed ten-minute rest before the interview.
errors:singular-countable-rest-needs-art.example: She needed a ten-minute rest before the interview.

errors:sit-in-the-coffee-drink-as-place.title: 把饮品名当作地点：sit in the coffee
errors:sit-in-the-coffee-drink-as-place.explanation: coffee 是饮品不是地点，不能 sit in。要表达地点需用地点名词，如 sit outside a coffee shop（坐在咖啡馆外）。
errors:sit-in-the-coffee-drink-as-place.source: Lovely day to sit in the coffee outside to drink coffee.
errors:sit-in-the-coffee-drink-as-place.example: Lovely day to sit outside a coffee shop with a coffee.

errors:slice-into-thin-slices-not-to-sli.title: 把“切成薄片”误写成 slice ... to slice
errors:slice-into-thin-slices-not-to-sli.explanation: slice 本身已经表示切片这个动作；如果要强调结果是薄片，英语通常说 slice something thinly 或 slice something into thin slices。to slice 不能表示“成为薄片”。
errors:slice-into-thin-slices-not-to-sli.source: Could you slice the onion to slice.
errors:slice-into-thin-slices-not-to-sli.example: Could you slice the onion into thin slices?

errors:smell-of-smoke-not-smoke-smell.title: 「烟味」说 the smell of smoke
errors:smell-of-smoke-not-smoke-smell.explanation: 英语习惯用 the smell of + 名词说明气味来源，比把两个名词直接并置（smoke smell）自然；the smoke smell 语法上可成立，但母语者日常更常用 the smell of smoke。
errors:smell-of-smoke-not-smoke-smell.source: I can't stand the smoke smell.
errors:smell-of-smoke-not-smoke-smell.example: I can't stand the smell of smoke.

errors:specific-known-plural-noun-use-th.title: 特定已知名词前需要 the
errors:specific-known-plural-noun-use-th.explanation: 当说话人和听话人都知道是哪一组人或哪样东西时，英语通常用 the，例如 the children、the chopsticks；省略 the 会变成泛指，语境不够准确。
errors:specific-known-plural-noun-use-th.example: She dished up hot soup for the children.

errors:sudden-adjective-not-suddenly-bef.title: 名词前用 sudden，不用 suddenly
errors:sudden-adjective-not-suddenly-bef.explanation: 修饰 rain 或 shower 这类名词需要形容词 sudden；副词 suddenly 用来修饰动词或整件事发生的方式。
errors:sudden-adjective-not-suddenly-bef.source: There was a suddenly rain in the afternoon, but it was sunny after ten minutes.
errors:sudden-adjective-not-suddenly-bef.example: There was a sudden shower in the afternoon, but the sun came out ten minutes later.

errors:suggest-object-plus-bare-verb-mis.title: suggest 后带宾语＋动词原形，缺少 that 或动名词
errors:suggest-object-plus-bare-verb-mis.explanation: suggest 不能接“宾语＋动词”，去掉 to 后依然错。表达“建议某人做某事”要用 suggest that 某人 do something（虚拟语气，动词原形），或 suggest doing；也可改用 advise someone to do。
errors:suggest-object-plus-bare-verb-mis.source: My friend suggested me go to the new cafe.
errors:suggest-object-plus-bare-verb-mis.example: My friend suggested that I go to the new cafe.

errors:suggest-someone-to-do-instead-of-.title: 误用 suggest someone to do 表达建议某人做某事
errors:suggest-someone-to-do-instead-of-.explanation: suggest 后面不能自然接 someone to do；表达“建议某人做某事”常用 suggest that someone do something，或改用 advise someone to do something。
errors:suggest-someone-to-do-instead-of-.source: The doctor suggests us to eat more fruit every day.
errors:suggest-someone-to-do-instead-of-.example: The doctor suggests that we eat more fruit every day.

errors:tense-and-exam-countability-in-tr.title: 翻译中时态和 exam/examination 数量不匹配
errors:tense-and-exam-countability-in-tr.explanation: 中文“给了”通常需要用过去时 gave；表示泛指备考时，exam/examination 常用复数 exams/examinations，或用特指 the exam。
errors:tense-and-exam-countability-in-tr.source: My teacher gives us a lot of advice about how to prepare for examination.
