errors:tense-and-exam-countability-in-tr.example: Our teacher gave us a lot of advice about how to prepare for exams.

errors:terminology-not-journal.title: 误把「学术期刊」译成 terminology（应为 academic journal）
errors:terminology-not-journal.explanation: terminology 指'术语/专业用语体系'，是抽象不可数名词，一般不说 terminologies；它不是'期刊'。'期刊'应为 journal / academic journal。译写时不要用 terminology 代替期刊。
errors:terminology-not-journal.source: The bookstore has a wide range of books from novels to terminologies.
errors:terminology-not-journal.example: The bookstore has a wide range of books, from novels to academic journals.

errors:thats-ok-for-accepting-request-un.title: 接受请求时 That's OK 不如 Sure / No problem 自然
errors:thats-ok-for-accepting-request-un.explanation: That's OK 常用于回应道歉、感谢或安慰别人；在别人请求帮忙时，Sure、No problem 或 Of course 更自然。
errors:thats-ok-for-accepting-request-un.source: That's ok. First, I'll pour the coffee, then I'll serve the egges.
errors:thats-ok-for-accepting-request-un.example: No problem. First, I'll pour the coffee, then I'll serve the eggs.

errors:the-typo-should-be-they.title: 主语代词误写为 the（The → They）
errors:the-typo-should-be-they.explanation: 主语位置应为人称代词 They（他们），误写成了定冠词 the；冠词不能单独作主语，写作时需检查主谓位置的代词拼写。
errors:the-typo-should-be-they.source: The finished the work a little bit earlier than planned.
errors:the-typo-should-be-they.example: They finished the work a little bit earlier than planned.

errors:there-be-cannot-take-second-finit.title: there be 结构后不能直接再接限定谓语
errors:there-be-cannot-take-second-finit.explanation: There were several birds 已经有限定谓语 were，不能再直接接限定动词 flew。表达鸟飞过湖面时，应以 birds 为主语直接使用 flew。
errors:there-be-cannot-take-second-finit.source: There were several birds flew over the lake slowly.
errors:there-be-cannot-take-second-finit.example: Several birds flew slowly over the lake.

errors:third-person-singular-present-s-e.title: 一般现在时第三人称单数漏加 -s
errors:third-person-singular-present-s-e.explanation: 在 when 引导的时间从句中，主语 the rain 是第三人称单数，表示将来条件时从句使用一般现在时 stops，而不是 stop。
errors:third-person-singular-present-s-e.source: When the rain stop, we can continue on toward the village.
errors:third-person-singular-present-s-e.example: When the rain stops, we can continue on toward the village.

errors:third-person-singular-s-in-depend.title: 第三人称单数从句谓语漏加 -s
errors:third-person-singular-s-in-depend.explanation: 一般现在时中，从句主语为第三人称单数时，谓语动词也要使用第三人称单数形式。
errors:third-person-singular-s-in-depend.source: As long as the manager approve the plan, we’ll begin the project.
errors:third-person-singular-s-in-depend.example: As soon as the manager approves the plan, we’ll begin the project.

errors:third-person-singular-s-missing-a.title: he 后一般现在时动词漏加 -s
errors:third-person-singular-s-missing-a.explanation: 一般现在时中，主语是第三人称单数 he/she/it 时，实义动词通常要加 -s；因此 he need 应改为 he needs。
errors:third-person-singular-s-missing-a.source: You could say he need to correct the sentence.
errors:third-person-singular-s-missing-a.example: You could say he needs to correct the sentence.

errors:third-person-singular-subject-nee.title: 第三人称单数主语后用 needs
errors:third-person-singular-subject-nee.explanation: 当主语是第三人称单数或不可数整体概念时，一般现在时里的普通动词要加 -s；my English 被当作一个整体能力，所以应写 needs，不是 need。
errors:third-person-singular-subject-nee.source: My English still need to be practicing.

errors:time-duration-before-noun-needs-s.title: 时间长度作定语时要用单数连字符结构
errors:time-duration-before-noun-needs-s.explanation: 表示‘十分钟的休息’时，英语通常把时间长度当作一个整体定语，写成 a ten-minute rest 或 a rest of ten minutes，而不是 ten minutes rest。minutes 在这里不是普通复数名词直接修饰 rest，而是被压缩进复合形容词里，单位通常保持单数。
errors:time-duration-before-noun-needs-s.source: He took ten-minutes rest before the meeting. / After ten-minutes rest, she went back to work.
errors:time-duration-before-noun-needs-s.example: He took a ten-minute rest before the meeting.

errors:traffic-versus-traffic-light-turn.title: turn green 的主语应为 traffic light 而非 traffic
errors:traffic-versus-traffic-light-turn.explanation: traffic 表示道路上的车辆流量或交通状况，信号变绿时应说 the light 或 the traffic light turns green。
errors:traffic-versus-traffic-light-turn.source: After the traffic turns green, we can continue on.
errors:traffic-versus-traffic-light-turn.example: After the traffic light turns green, we can continue on.

errors:turn-off-electronic-device-colloc.title: 关闭电子设备应使用 turn off
errors:turn-off-electronic-device-colloc.explanation: 表示关闭手机等电子设备通常使用 turn off，而不是 close；多人各自的手机通常用复数 their phones。
errors:turn-off-electronic-device-colloc.example: They turned off their phones before the tour began.

errors:unlike-used-instead-of-do-not-lik.title: 把 unlike 当作动词短语 do not like 使用
errors:unlike-used-instead-of-do-not-lik.explanation: unlike 通常作介词或形容词，表示“不像”；表达“不喜欢某事”要用 do not like 或 dislike。
errors:unlike-used-instead-of-do-not-lik.source: The expression is used to describe people who unlike society communication.
errors:unlike-used-instead-of-do-not-lik.example: The expression is usually used to describe people who do not like social communication.

errors:use-eastward-for-neutral-directio.title: 纯方向移动用 eastward，不用 back east
errors:use-eastward-for-neutral-directio.explanation: back east 带有回到东部地区、老家或熟悉区域的语义，不能用于风暴、物体、路线等只表示向东移动的场景；纯方向移动应使用 eastward。
errors:use-eastward-for-neutral-directio.source: The storm moved back east across the plains overnight.
errors:use-eastward-for-neutral-directio.example: The storm moved eastward across the plains overnight.

errors:use-in-or-at-not-on-before-meetin.title: 会议场合用 in/at the meeting，不用 on meeting
errors:use-in-or-at-not-on-before-meetin.explanation: 表示在一次会议这个场合中，英语通常说 in the meeting 或 at the meeting；on meeting 不能自然表达‘在会议上’。
errors:use-in-or-at-not-on-before-meetin.source: I dont want to talk about the problem on meeting.
errors:use-in-or-at-not-on-before-meetin.example: I dont want to talk about the problem at the meeting.

errors:use-stay-instead-of-stop-for-rema.title: 表示留下来应用 stay，而不是 stop
errors:use-stay-instead-of-stop-for-rema.explanation: stop 通常表示停止动作或短暂停靠，不能自然表达决定继续住在或留在某地；表达‘留下来’应使用 stay、remain 或 settle there 等。
errors:use-stay-instead-of-stop-for-rema.source: He disliked the city at first, but then he decided to stop here.
errors:use-stay-instead-of-stop-for-rema.example: He disliked the city at first, but then he decided to stay there.

errors:used-to-missing-base-verb.title: used to 后不能省略动作动词
errors:used-to-missing-base-verb.explanation: 表示过去的习惯或状态时，used to 后接动词原形；back east 只说明地点，不能代替 live。应使用 used to live back east。
errors:used-to-missing-base-verb.source: My uncle used to back east, but now he lives in California.
errors:used-to-missing-base-verb.example: My uncle used to live back east, but now he lives in California.

errors:using-shall-you-for-friendly-sugg.title: 误用 Shall you...? 表达友好建议
errors:using-shall-you-for-friendly-sugg.explanation: 表达“我们一起做某事好吗？”时要用 Shall we...?；Shall you...? 不能自然地表示邀请对方一起做某事。
errors:using-shall-you-for-friendly-sugg.example: Shall we order some coffee before the meeting?

errors:vegetarian-food-rendered-as-veget.title: 「素食」误写成 vegetables
errors:vegetarian-food-rendered-as-veget.explanation: vegetables 指具体的蔬菜这种食材；「素食（不含荤食的餐食）」是 vegetarian food，指一类饮食，不是某几种蔬菜。只供应素食应说 serve only vegetarian food。
errors:vegetarian-food-rendered-as-veget.source: The coffee shop only serves vegetables.
errors:vegetarian-food-rendered-as-veget.example: The café serves only vegetarian food.

errors:visit-someone-in-place-not-to-pla.title: visit someone in a place，而不是 visit someone to a place
errors:visit-someone-in-place-not-to-pla.explanation: visit 后面直接接人或地点；如果要同时表达地点，常用 visit someone in + place，或 go/travel to + place to visit someone。
errors:visit-someone-in-place-not-to-pla.source: She lives in New York, but she visits her friends to Los Angeles every summer.
errors:visit-someone-in-place-not-to-pla.example: She lives in New York, but she goes to Los Angeles to visit her friends every summer.

errors:wait-for-someone-not-wait-someone.title: wait for someone：等某人
errors:wait-for-someone-not-wait-someone.explanation: wait 作不及物动词表示等待时，后面接等待对象要用介词 for；不能直接说 wait a friend。
errors:wait-for-someone-not-wait-someone.source: I am waiting a friend who lives nearby.
errors:wait-for-someone-not-wait-someone.example: I am waiting for a friend who lives nearby.

errors:walk-along-coast-not-along-sea.title: 沿着海边走用 along the coast / seafront
errors:walk-along-coast-not-along-sea.explanation: sea 指大片水域本身，人走的是岸线，所以“沿海边走”用 walk along the coast、along the seafront 或 by the sea。
errors:walk-along-coast-not-along-sea.source: We walked along the sea after supper.
errors:walk-along-coast-not-along-sea.example: We walked along the coast after supper.

errors:walk-past-not-walk-pass-landmark.title: 经过某地用 walk past，不用 walk pass
errors:walk-past-not-walk-pass-landmark.explanation: 描述经过某个地点时，past 是介词，表示从旁边经过；pass 通常作动词，若直接跟地点作宾语，应说 pass the restaurant，而不是 walk pass the restaurant。
errors:walk-past-not-walk-pass-landmark.source: Walk pass the restaurant and turn left at the second intersection.
errors:walk-past-not-walk-pass-landmark.example: Walk past the restaurant and turn right at the second intersection.

errors:want-to-base-verb-not-gerund.title: want to do：want 后接 to + 动词原形
errors:want-to-base-verb-not-gerund.explanation: want 表示想要做某事时，后面通常接 to + 动词原形；不要写成 want to doing。
errors:want-to-base-verb-not-gerund.source: He doesn't want to going out with his colleague, because that will makes work embarrassing.
errors:want-to-base-verb-not-gerund.example: He doesn't want to go out with his colleague because that will make work embarrassing.

errors:weather-shower-there-was-not-it-h.title: 描述阵雨用 there was a shower，不用天气 it had a shower
errors:weather-shower-there-was-not-it-h.explanation: 天气 it 可用于 It was drizzling，但不能沿用为 had a shower 的主语；have a shower 通常表示洗澡。描述发生一阵雨用 there was a shower 或 we had a shower。
errors:weather-shower-there-was-not-it-h.source: It was drizzling in the morning and suddenly had a shower after lunch, but it stopped after ten minutes.
errors:weather-shower-there-was-not-it-h.example: It was drizzling all morning, and there was suddenly a heavy shower after lunch, but it stopped after ten minutes.

errors:when-clause-open-event-tense.title: when 从句描述开业事件的动词和时态
errors:when-clause-open-event-tense.explanation: 表达“某地刚开业的时候”应使用 opened 或 had just opened，而不是 close；在 remember when... 中，when 从句通常用过去时或过去完成时来描述被回忆的过去事件。
errors:when-clause-open-event-tense.source: Many old-timers still remember when the theatre just close.
errors:when-clause-open-event-tense.example: Many old-timers still remember when the theater had just opened.

errors:while-clause-missing-linking-verb.title: while 时间状语从句缺系动词
errors:while-clause-missing-linking-verb.explanation: while 引导时间状语从句时必须带完整主谓结构，不能省略 be 动词，原句 while I outside 缺了 was。同时注意语义：要表达“出门时已经停了”，更自然的是 by the time I went out, it had stopped，而不是 while I was outside（后者会让人理解为雨是在你还在外面的时候才停）。
errors:while-clause-missing-linking-verb.source: It was a shower in the morning and it had stopped while I outside.
errors:while-clause-missing-linking-verb.example: By the time I went out, it had already stopped.

errors:wide-range-of-singular-head-verb-.title: a wide range of + 复数名词作主语时谓语应与单数中心词 range 一致
errors:wide-range-of-singular-head-verb-.explanation: a wide range of activities 的中心词是单数名词 range（quantifier 结构 a ... range of ...），activities 只是介词 of 的宾语，所以谓语用单数 is/was，不用 are 或 will be 这类另起时态的写法。同类结构 a variety of / a series of 也按中心词定单复数。
errors:wide-range-of-singular-head-verb-.source: A wide range of activities will be available during the festival.
errors:wide-range-of-singular-head-verb-.example: A wide range of activities is available during the festival.

errors:word-choice-topic-not-motif.title: topic（主题/话题）误用为 motif（艺术作品的母题）
errors:word-choice-topic-not-motif.explanation: motif 指文学、音乐、装饰艺术中反复出现的母题或图案母题，属于专业术语；报告、文章、讨论所涉及的内容范围用 topics 或 subjects。语境是报告涵盖议题时，只能选 topics。
errors:word-choice-topic-not-motif.source: The report covered a wide range of motifs.
errors:word-choice-topic-not-motif.example: The report covers a wide range of topics, from climate to education.

errors:worth-no-preposition.title: worth 直接接宾语，不加 of
errors:worth-no-preposition.explanation: worth 是形容词性补语词，后面直接跟名词、代词或动名词，不需要介词 of；be worth it 表示“值得”。
errors:worth-no-preposition.source: and some of them say it was worth of it
errors:worth-no-preposition.example: Some of them say the sacrifice was worth it.

errors:you-used-instead-of-your-before-n.title: 名词前误用 you 代替 your
errors:you-used-instead-of-your-before-n.explanation: 修饰名词 orders 表示“你的订单”时要用形容词性物主代词 your，不能用主格/宾格 you。
errors:you-used-instead-of-your-before-n.source: We will proceed with you orders after the pay is confirmed.
errors:you-used-instead-of-your-before-n.example: We will proceed with your order after the payment is confirmed.
